jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator \- Overview**

Pixl Sauce is seeking a Project Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone of a high\-output content studio. This role ensures schedules, shoots, handoffs, and deliveries stay aligned across multiple creative and production teams.

This is a fully in\-office role that works closely with internal departments and client\-side partners.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the master production calendar across all content initiatives
* Coordinate schedules, logistics, and resourcing across teams
* Manage timelines, deliverables, and internal handoffs
* Track review cycles, approvals, and final deliveries
* Serve as a central point of communication between internal teams and client\-side stakeholders
* Identify bottlenecks and proactively resolve them
* Help refine workflows as volume and complexity grow

**Ideal Candidate**

* 4\+ years in production or content project coordinator
* Exceptionally organized with strong written communication skills
* Comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously
* Experience working with client\-side teams and approvals
* Proactive, calm, and detail\-oriented
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative, in\-office environment

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:

**Commercial Construction Asst. Project Manager/Coordinator**  

**Project Controls and Field Coordination**  

Benefits: Health insurance • Vision insurance • Dental insurance • 401(k) matching • Company car  

**Be the Person Who Connects the Field, Project Manager, and Leadership**
=========================================================================


At BF Construction Inc., successful projects happen because the team is looking ahead, asking the right questions, following through on commitments, and keeping the field and office aligned.  

We are looking for an Assistant Project Manager with commercial construction experience who wants to continue growing toward a Project Manager role.  

  

  

This position works directly with Project Managers, Superintendents, Field Leads, subcontractors, vendors, and Leadership to support active commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.  

  

  

The ideal candidate understands construction, is highly organized and detail\-oriented, follows through consistently, and takes ownership of execution.  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
==================



  

Project Controls and Scheduling  

* Help maintain and drive active project schedules and the company Master Schedule


* Build and maintain one\- and two\-week lookaheads


* Coordinate upcoming work with Project Managers, Superintendents/Field Leads, subcontractors, and vendors


* Identify schedule conflicts, missing information, delays, and sequencing risks


* Confirm completed work and update schedules when field conditions or decisions change



  

Subcontractor, Vendor, and Procurement Coordination  

* Coordinate subcontractors, vendors, manpower, material deliveries, equipment, inspections, access, and logistics


* Track procurement and long\-lead materials


* Follow open commitments through completion and flag missing or unconfirmed dates before they affect production



  

Field Coordination  

* Review field progress, Daily Project Updates, SiteCam photos, and project documentation


* Confirm reported progress aligns with actual field conditions


* Identify incomplete work, missing information, and coordination issues


* Maintain constant communication with Field Leads, including, but not limited to performing weekly project planning meetings



  

Project Documentation and Follow\-Through  

* Review drawings, specifications, Bluebeam markups, RFIs, and submittals


* Track RFIs, submittals, procurement items, change\-order follow\-up, and project action items


* Maintain accurate project records and communicate updates clearly


* Follow assigned actions through completion with detail, consistency, and accountability


**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**
=========================


* This is not a purely administrative support role. The APM is expected to understand the project, stay organized, and actively support planning and execution.


* This is not simply maintaining schedules and project documents. This role requires close attention to detail, accurate follow\-through, and consistent execution from one step to the next.


* This is not a position that waits for the Project Manager or Leadership to identify every issue. The APM should recognize risks, missing information, and upcoming needs early and help drive them through resolution.


**WHAT YOU BRING**
==================


* 3\+ years of commercial construction experience


* Experience as a Project Engineer, Assistant Project Manager, Construction Project Coordinator, or similar construction role


* Ability to read and understand construction plans, specifications, and project documents


* Working knowledge of commercial construction sequencing and project workflow


* Experience with schedules, subcontractors, procurement, RFIs, submittals, and field coordination


* Strong attention to detail with consistent follow\-through and execution


* Ability to manage multiple priorities without losing accuracy or missing commitments


* Clear communication, strong organization, and a problem\-solving mindset


* Desire to grow into a commercial construction Project Manager


**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**
========================


* Commercial tenant improvements, renovations, site work, exterior and/or ground\-up construction


* Smartsheet or comparable scheduling software


* Bluebeam and Procore or comparable construction\-management software


* Microsoft 365, Slack, Dropbox, and field\-documentation systems such as SiteCam


**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================


* Project schedules and documentation remain accurate and current


* Upcoming subcontractors, materials, inspections, and project needs are identified early


* Field progress is accurately reflected in the project plan


* Risks, missing information, and open items are communicated before they affect the schedule


* Commitments and action items are followed through consistently


* Project Managers and Superintendents can rely on the APM for accurate, detailed execution


**HARD REQUIREMENT**
====================


Candidates must have direct commercial construction experience and a working understanding of project schedules, subcontractor coordination, procurement, field conditions, and construction documentation.  

This role is designed for someone who already has a construction foundation and is ready to take on greater project\-management responsibility.  

**CAREER PATH**
===============


**Assistant Project Manager**  **Project Manager**  **Senior Project Manager**  

BF Construction is committed to developing people who want to build a long\-term career in construction project management. You will work directly with experienced Project Managers, Superintendents, Field Leads, and Leadership while learning BF Construction’s systems, processes, and standards.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About AADAP, Inc.**

The Asian American Drug Abuse Program (AADAP) is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to serving Asian Pacific Islanders and other underserved communities with substance abuse services throughout Los Angeles County. Programs and services are provided to all individuals regardless of race or ethnicity.

**Department Overview**

Youth \& Family Programs (YFP) provides AADAP’s Gang Reduction and Youth Development (GRYD) Prevention services. The program works with youth, families, community partners, and public agencies to support prevention, family case management, youth development, and community education activities.

**Position Summary**

The GRYD Program Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day operations and coordination of AADAP’s GRYD Prevention program. This position provides direct supervision and support to program staff, coordinates service delivery, monitors program performance and documentation, and helps ensure contractual and program requirements are met.

The Program Coordinator also serves as a liaison with the GRYD Office, LAPD, intervention partners, community organizations, and other stakeholders. The ideal candidate is an organized and collaborative supervisor who can support staff, manage competing priorities, and build strong relationships with youth, families, and community partners.

**Essential Job Functions \& Responsibilities**

**Program Coordination \& Service Delivery**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day GRYD program activities and ensure services align with program goals and objectives.
* Monitor program activities and action steps to support timely and effective implementation.
* Guide staff through GRYD implementation and program services.
* Coordinate and support GRYD Prevention and Family Case Management services.
* Support youth development activities, community education campaigns, and other program activities.
* Monitor the quality and quantity of services and take appropriate action to help ensure contract requirements and program goals are met.
* Participate in meetings and trainings relevant to the program’s target population and geographic area.

**Staff Supervision \& Development**

* Supervise Primary and Secondary level program staff, including regular check\-ins, performance monitoring, coaching, and support.
* Assess staff training and development needs and coordinate required GRYD and agency training.
* Conduct annual performance evaluations consistent with agency policy.
* Provide training, technical assistance, and consultation to GRYD and support staff.
* Support the recruitment and hiring of line staff, including candidate screening, interviewing, and hiring recommendations.

**Program Administration \& Compliance**

* Monitor and review GRYD case files and ETO data entry for completeness and accuracy.
* Prepare and submit required reports and billing documentation.
* Monitor GRYD case management performance and other program benchmarks.
* Monitor program expenditures in coordination with program leadership.
* Assist the Director with contract\-related activities, proposal writing, and fund\-seeking efforts.
* Perform duties of the Unit Director in their absence, as assigned.

**Community \& Partner Engagement**

* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with the GRYD Office, LAPD, intervention partners, schools, community organizations, and other stakeholders.
* Serve as a liaison between AADAP services, GRYD programs, and outside services and programs.
* Represent AADAP and the program at community meetings, events, and partner activities.
* Support community outreach, youth development activities, and community education efforts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Six (6\) years of college education in a related field or equivalent work experience related to the field.
* At least two (2\) years of supervision experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Bilingual or bicultural proficiency in Arabic, Armenian, Cantonese, Farsi, Urdu, Khmer (Cambodian), Korean, Mandarin, Russian, Spanish, Tagalog, Vietnamese, or another language reflective of the communities served.
* Familiarity with the program target area and surrounding community.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

* Demonstrated knowledge and skills in computer operations.
* Strong leadership and staff supervision skills.
* Strong organizational, planning, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, documentation requirements, and deadlines.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, coworkers, youth, families, community organizations, partner agencies, and the general public.
* Ability to provide constructive feedback, coaching, and support to staff.
* Ability to work effectively and respectfully with people of diverse cultural, educational, social, and economic backgrounds.
* Professional, dependable, collaborative, and tactful approach to working with others.
* Ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse cultural, educational, social, and economic backgrounds.

**Special Requirements**

* Employment contingent upon successful background check clearance.
* Proof of work eligibility required upon hire.
* Valid California Driver’s License, minimum automobile insurance, and access to a reliable motor vehicle.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including some evenings and weekends.

**Work Schedule, Travel \& Physical Demands**

* **Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week; requires flexibility for some evening and weekend program activities.
* **Travel:** Local travel is required for program activities, meetings, community events, and partner engagement.
* **Physical Requirements:** Light\-duty work. The position requires regular sitting, standing, walking, speaking, reading, writing, and computer use. May occasionally require lifting up to approximately 10 pounds and bending, stooping, squatting, climbing stairs, or similar movem

jobs.title: Part-time Mentoring and Literacy Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator**

**Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP)** 

**Serving Vine Street Elementary, Los Angeles, CA 90038**

**Location:** Vine Street Elementary School, 955 Vine Street, Los Angeles, CA 90038

**Schedule and Hours:** Up to 5 days a week, Monday through Friday. Hours will vary between approximately 10:45 am and 12:45 pm from September through June. Training and onboarding for the position will begin upon hire in August. Some availability is required outside of these times for data entry, communications, and meetings as needed. Up to 10 hours per week.

**Position Overview**

Do you believe every child deserves a caring mentor and the opportunity to fall in love with reading? Join Read to a Child as a Program Coordinator, where you'll play a vital role in bringing our Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP) to life. By coordinating volunteers, partnering with schools, and supporting meaningful mentor\-student relationships, you'll help elementary students build confidence, improve literacy skills, and experience the power of reading.

Our Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP) pairs volunteer mentors with Kindergarten through 4th grade students for a fun and rewarding weekly read\-aloud session during the school day. As the Program Coordinator, you'll be the heart of the program at your assigned school, ensuring every mentor, student, and school partner enjoys a positive, well\-organized, and impactful experience.

In this role, you'll coordinate the day\-to\-day operations of the program, build strong relationships with volunteers and school staff, manage scheduling and program records, and help create an environment where students can thrive.

**The current open Program Coordinator role is an on\-site position working in schools directly with students. Successful candidates must be comfortable working in an in\-school environment and in keeping with all safety protocols required by the school, as well as be comfortable/confident working with technology.**

This role is extremely important to the program’s function and success and will be an integral part of a fun and collaborative team! Our Program Coordinators are truly the face of our program and make a real difference in the lives of our students every year.

If you're organized, people\-focused, and passionate about making a difference in your community, we'd love to hear from you!

**Specific Job Responsibilities Will Include All or Some of the Following (will vary by Region \& School/Site)**

1\. Program Operations \& Coordination

* Ensure smooth program start\-up, including school partnership logistics (relationships, space, scheduling, absences, referrals, permissions, matching pairs)
* Facilitate and monitor reading sessions, which may be in\-person and/or virtual, to ensure smooth operation of program
* If coordinating on\-site, ensure hygiene/safety guidelines are followed and rooms are left clean and orderly
* Provide volunteers with book ideas; maintain an organized and inviting book cart (on\-site programs only)
* Facilitate other activities or tasks as requested (e.g., supporting other schools)

2\. Communication \& Relationship Management

* Communicate regularly with supervisor
* Communicate with volunteer mentors: provide program updates, notify of student absences, and share schedule changes
* Notify students, teachers, and potentially parents/guardians of volunteer mentor cancellations or schedule changes
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to volunteer mentors, including general and case\-specific advice (with supervisor input)

3\. Data Management \& Administrative Tasks

* Document reading session attendance and participant information changes in the database
* Collect mid\-year and year\-end surveys/assessments from mentors, students, and teachers
* Submit timesheets accurately and on time

4\. Volunteer Engagement \& Support

* Support volunteer recruitment efforts
* Assist students in making thank\-you cards for mentors
* Plan and implement year\-end celebration (as applicable)

5\. Training \& Professional Development

* Attend required Program Coordinator training sessions and meetings
* Participate in performance evaluation and goal\-setting process
* Interested Program Coordinators may be able to take on some Program Assistant roles (virtually or in person) at other schools

**Essential Job Duties For In\-Person Positions** This person working in this position will be in a school setting. It involves constant movement throughout the building and designated session areas, guiding students to their reading session. Depending on the school, this may require occasionally ascending/descending stairs. It also requires frequent positioning of books and/or program materials of various weights and sizes on a rolling book cart, as well as rolling the book cart to/from various locations within the school.

**Key Qualifications**

* Commitment to Read to a Child’s mission, viability and growth
* Experience working with young children
* Enthusiastic about children’s books, willingness to become familiar with the Read to a Child book collection
* Preferred \- Experience managing volunteers
* Communicates well in person, virtually, on the telephone \& via email
* Commitment to actively and continuously working toward achieving the organization’s Diversity, Equity and Inclusion goals
* Extremely organized and adept at successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously and prioritizing according to the organization’s strategic plan \-\- with flexibility and a positive attitude
* Comfortable working with and hosting group video conference platforms (eg: Zoom and/or Google Meets)
* Proficiency working with various technological platforms: E\-mail, Google Drive, word processing, spreadsheets, E\-book sources, and some data entry
* Access to transportation

***NOTE: Your application will not be considered without a cover letter.***

*Read to a Child is committed to providing resources to children most impacted

* Manage provider and consumer onboarding pipelines, ensuring progress through onboarding, service initiation, and required milestones
* Support provider onboarding activities including documentation collection, provider matching, scheduling, and onboarding readiness
* Maintain compliance and documentation standards by verifying eligibility requirements, certifications, background checks, and accurate recordkeeping
* Collaborate with Operations and Regional Center teams while maintaining tracking systems, reporting, and onboarding status updates

  


**These positions are hired for locations across California. If you are comfortable commuting to our branch offices (Los Angeles, Concord, Fullerton, Riverside, Oxnard, Bakersfield, or Roseville) office 3x per week, we would love to set up some time to chat!**

* Experience supporting onboarding, intake coordination, or operational workflows preferred
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain organized documentation
* Positive, service\-oriented attitude with strong follow\-through

* Communication and relationship building
* Organization and follow\-up management
* Confidentiality and sound judgment
* Time management and attention to detail

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**

A leading aerospace metals manufacturer is seeking a **Logistics Coordinator** to support shipping, inventory, and warehouse operations. This role works closely with the Logistics Supervisor and Logistics Manager to ensure customer orders are processed accurately and shipped on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in manufacturing, aerospace, metals, forging, warehousing, shipping, or inventory control who enjoys a fast\-paced environment and takes pride in accuracy, organization, and customer service.

**Key ResponsibilitiesShipping \& Logistics Coordination**

* Create and process delivery orders to support customer requirements and shipment schedules
* Review inventory, sales orders, and customer portals to ensure on\-time deliveries
* Schedule domestic and international shipments
* Generate pick lists and shipping documentation
* Coordinate with certification teams to ensure proper shipment release
* Process bills of lading, shipping labels, ASNs, and export documentation
* Maintain accurate shipment records for audit compliance
* Coordinate pickups with freight carriers and transportation providers
* Process freight invoices and related shipping paperwork

**Inventory Management**

* Monitor inventory levels and maintain min/max stock requirements
* Review customer consignment inventory and internal stocking levels
* Track aging inventory and communicate recommendations to management
* Perform cycle count administration and inventory reconciliation
* Update ERP transactions and maintain inventory accuracy records

**Quality \& Customer Support**

* Assist with customer returns and discrepancy investigations
* Support resolution of quality\-related concerns
* Communicate with customers regarding shipment status and delivery issues
* Escalate concerns and work with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction

**Reporting \& Metrics**

* Prepare reports on:
* Inventory levels
* Shipping performance
* On\-time delivery
* Lead times
* Quality performance
* Warehouse metrics

**General Office \& Administrative Support**

* Handle incoming calls and direct inquiries appropriately
* Process incoming and outgoing mail and courier services
* Coordinate office supply purchasing
* Support facility and vendor communication as needed
* Assist with budget tracking and administrative reporting

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Train and support Logistics Clerks
* Participate in internal ISO audits when required
* Request maintenance and repairs for equipment as needed
* Support safety, quality, environmental, and operational initiatives

**Qualifications Required**

* Minimum 1 year of logistics, shipping, inventory, warehouse, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing environment
* Experience with ERP systems and shipping transactions
* Strong organizational and communication skills
* Ability to work in a team\-oriented production environment
* Must be able to pass a background check and drug screen
* Must comply with ITAR and EAR requirements

**Preferred**

* Experience in aerospace, metals, forging, machining, or industrial manufacturing
* Knowledge of international shipping, export documentation, customs, or freight coordination
* Experience with cycle counting and inventory control

**We're looking for someone who:**

* Has experience in manufacturing logistics or shipping within a manufacturing
* Understands inventory control and ERP transactions
* Is highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Thrives in a fast\-paced production environment
* Takes ownership of safety, quality, and on\-time delivery performance
* Wants an opportunity that has strong potential to become a long\-term role

**Apply today to join a stable aerospace manufacturer supporting critical aerospace and defense programs.**

Pay: Up to $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Experience:

* Logistics Coordinating: 2 years (Required)
* Inventory management: 2 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Paramount, CA 90723 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Group Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
This position requires previous hotel experience.

The **Group Sales Coordinator** is responsible for supporting the sales team by coordinating Group and corporate account reservations, room blocks, events and other administrative duties. Main tasks include inputting and maintaining rooming lists, billing and reservation notes; monitoring and actioning the hotel reservations inbox; updating Group Resumes and BEOs with the sales team; and general sales communication with hotel departments.  
This position also supports the overall Sales \& Catering team at Hotel Angeleno.

**Sales Coordinator Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure that all sales room blocks, meetings and events, billing procedures, trace dates and any other necessary arrangements are transmitted correctly in the system prior to guest / group arrival.
* Work with Director of Sales \& Marketing, Sales Managers, Finance, and other team members to ensure accurate data reporting internally and to the client.
* Ensure sales clients can make reservations and count on the hotel for accurate and timely billing by completing the following tasks: set up billing (follow SOP’s), follow up with client on rooming lists and enter the names in the PMS, track commission payments, track group no shows, review VIP group reservations and confirm they are blocked in the correct room types.
* Distribute all documents correctly and on a timely basis to the client and necessary internal departments.
* Monitor guest room block and blocked event space to ensure group is meeting their contractual obligations.
* Perform all administrative duties in a tidy, organized manner and help maintain sales office orderly at all times.
* Prepare and / or update written communications: memorandums, BEOs, Group Resumes, event floorplans, maintain and create sales spreadsheets, sales letters, cover letters, thank you letters, mailings, collateral, ordering supplies etc.
* Communicate all last\-minute changes, additions and cancellations to all departments.
* Ensure that all sales entries and changes are entered in Opera accurately
* Prepare all necessary sales reports
* Process all purchase orders and special requests
* Follow up on audio\-visual needs and set\-up requests prior to event date as needed
* Ensure all billing requirements are met
* Work with the banquet operation to ensure the highest standards of service, comparing BEO items against actual sets and service
* Answer all telephone and email inquiries in a pleasant, courteous and professional manner and ensure that all pertinent information is noted accurately and legibly and quickly communicated to respective Sales Managers.
* Be organized and detail oriented.
* Professional while maintaining communication with sales team and all departments.
* Posting Payments
* Upkeep and inventory of Sales Collateral (brochures, marketing materials and menus etc.,)
* Set up and coordinate site inspections for Sales Managers with other departments and clients
* Update and monitor client lists for emails blasts with Director of Sales
* Assist Sales Managers with daily office duties
* ·Assist Sales Managers with prepping for tradeshows, packing and mailing collateral etc.,
* Generate Month End Reports: (Pace/Transient Production/Production)
* Set Up Amenities for VIPs

**Event Operations Manager**

**Location:** California (LA/San Diego) (Regional travel required)

**Contract:** Weekly / Event\-Based. Average 16\-30 hrs per week.

**Rate of Pay:** $28 per hour

**About XL Event Lab**

XL Event Lab is an international live events company producing a portfolio of successful

touring entertainment experiences across multiple markets.

As we continue to expand across North America, we're looking for an Event Operations

Manager to help deliver exceptional live events throughout California (LA/San Diego).

**The Role**

Reporting to the Head of Regional Development – Live Events, you'll take responsibility

for the operational delivery of our events once venues have been secured. From planning

and preparation through to the final guest leaving the venue, you'll ensure every event is

delivered safely, professionally and to an exceptional standard.

This is a practical, hands\-on role. You'll lead Event Crew, transport equipment, liaise with

venues, solve problems as they arise and ensure every event delivers a first\-class guest

experience.

If you enjoy leading people, thrive in fast\-paced environments and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, we'd love to hear from you.

***What You'll Be Doing***

**Event Delivery**

* Lead the operational delivery of live events across your region.
* Act as the operational lead on event day.
* Ensure events run safely, efficiently and on schedule.
* Resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.

**Venue Operations**

* Take ownership of venue operations following contract confirmation.
* Liaise directly with venue staff before and during each event.
* Ensure all operational requirements are in place ahead of every event.

**Team Leadership**

* Schedule Event Crew for upcoming events.
* Lead pre\-event briefings and provide direction throughout each event.
* Foster a positive, professional team environment.

**Equipment \& Logistics**

* Transport event equipment to and from venues using a U\-Haul vehicle.
* Manage event setup and pack\-down.
* Maintain equipment and monitor inventory levels.

**Guest Experience**

* Deliver an outstanding customer experience from arrival through to departure.
* Handle guest queries and resolve issues professionally.
* Represent XL Event Lab and our event brands to the highest standard.

**About You**

You'll be organised, dependable and comfortable taking responsibility for live events.

Previous experience in live events would be advantageous, but we'd also welcome

candidates from hospitality, visitor attractions, theatres, tourism or similar customer\-facing

environments.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working as part of a team, take pride in delivering exceptional

experiences and remain calm under pressure.

**Working Pattern**

This role is centered around our live event schedule.

Most work takes place on Fridays and Saturdays, with occasional Thursday and Sunday

events depending on the tour schedule. Hours will average between 16\-30 each week.

Regular travel throughout California is required, with overnight stays only occasionally

necessary.

**Why Join XL Event Lab?**

* Join an established international live events company.
* Play a key role in delivering memorable live experiences.
* Work in a varied, hands\-on role where no two event days are the same.
* Become part of a growing business with ambitious plans across North America.

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

jobs.description:
Good Systems is the parent company behind Goodnotes, where millions of people capture and develop their ideas.  

Goodnotes is where we started, and it's now the foundation for a growing family of products. By reimagining how we interact with information, we're bringing together human creativity and the breakthrough capabilities of AI.  

We build products that help people turn good thinking into good work.

**Our Values:**
---------------


**Dream big**  

* Be visionary, strategic, and open to innovation

**Build great things**  

* Work in service of our users, always improving and pushing higher

**Operate like an owner**  

* Take responsibility with bold decision\-making and bias for action

**Win like a sports team**  

* Be trusting and collaborative while empowering others

**Learn and grow fast**  

* Never stop learning and iterate fast

**Share our passion**  

* Share ideas and practice enthusiasm and joy

**Be user obsessed**  

* Empathetic, inquisitive, practical

### **About the team:**



You will be joining our Enterprise team, which is focused on bringing Goodnotes to the professional industry space. We work with businesses and organisations across international markets to help them unlock the full potential of digital paper in their day\-to\-day workflows. The USA is one of our most important growth territories, and this BDR role is at the front line of that expansion — generating the pipeline that fuels our enterprise sales motion.


### **About the role:**



As a Business Development Representative for the USA, you will own top\-of\-funnel pipeline generation across your assigned territory, identifying and qualifying new business opportunities and handing off Sales\-Qualified Leads and Deals (SQLs) to our Account Executive team. You will be the first point of contact for many prospective customers in the Mid\-Market and Enterprise sector, setting the tone for what it feels like to work with Goodnotes. You will work closely with our Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product Development teams to execute targeted outbound campaigns, follow up on inbound leads, and continuously refine your approach based on data and feedback.  

  

**This is the role for you, if you're excited to work on the things listed below:**


* **Own your pipeline:** Take full responsibility for prospecting and outbound activity across your US territory — researching target accounts, identifying key decision\-makers, and building a consistent flow of qualified opportunities for the AE team.

* **Book and brief AEs:** Schedule discovery calls and demos or follow\-up meetings for Account Executives, ensuring smooth handoffs with thorough context and qualification notes so no momentum is lost.
* **Support field and digital events:** Represent Goodnotes at US\-based industry events, webinars, and conferences to generate pipeline through in\-person and virtual engagement.
* **Feed the feedback loop:** Share structured insights from prospect conversations back to Marketing and Product — including common objections, competitor mentions, use cases, and messaging that resonates.
* **Leverage data to prioritise:** Use HubSpot CRM and sales intelligence tools to manage your pipeline, track activity, and prioritise outreach based on territory data and account signals.
* **Collaborate cross\-functionally:** Work closely with Marketing on campaign follow\-up and lead hand\-offs, and with Account Executives to align on ideal customer profiles, messaging, and territory strategy.


**The skills you will need to be successful in the above:**


* 1–2 years of experience in a BDR, SDR, or outbound sales role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
* Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding SQL or pipeline generation targets
* Native or fluent English speaker, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Spanish language skills are a plus (not required), particularly for engaging with a diverse US customer base
* Strong understanding of the US enterprise landscape, including how buying decisions are made across different industries and company sizes
* Comfort and confidence with cold outreach — phone, email, and social — and the resilience to handle rejection with a positive mindset
* Ability to quickly grasp and articulate a product's value proposition in a compelling, tailored way
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of accounts and outreach sequences simultaneously
* Experience with HubSpot CRM
* Proactive, coachable mindset with a genuine desire to grow into a closing role over time
* Familiarity with AI tools and workflows as part of a modern prospecting motion is a strong plus


Even if you don't meet all the criteria listed above, we would still love to hear from you! Goodnotes places a lot of value on learning and development and will support your growth if needed.

jobs.description:
**Join SmartFinancial: Empowering Insurers with Cutting\-Edge Technology**


Welcome to SmartFinancial, where our mission is clear: to drive growth and success for insurance agencies through our industry\-leading technology! Voted one of the Best Places to Work for four consecutive years, we are one of the fastest\-growing tech companies.


We are a leading insurance marketplace, connecting millions of shoppers to our network of insurance partners across all 50 states.

**Why This Role Matters**


As a **Customer Success Manager 1** at SmartFinancial, you’ll play a key role in helping insurance agents and agencies succeed on our platform. You’ll manage a growing book of business, build strong client relationships, and work directly with customers to help them maximize the value and performance of their accounts.


This is a entry\-level, in\-office role designed for someone who is motivated by building relationships, solving problems, and achieving measurable results. You’ll work with smaller accounts, re\-engage customers through our win\-back dialer, and identify opportunities to grow accounts to higher monthly spending levels.


CSM1s who consistently meet and exceed performance expectations will be eligible to advance into **Customer Success Manager 2 (CSM2\)** or **Strategic Customer Success Manager (SCSM)** roles.


Our goal is to become the premier Customer Success Team in the Insurtech industry, and you will be an important part of making that happen.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Grow:** Manage a book of **100\+ active accounts**, building strong relationships while identifying opportunities to increase account utilization and monthly spend.
* **Win Back:** Work our win\-back dialer to re\-engage inactive and lower\-spending customers, build your book of business, and create new opportunities for account growth.
* **Optimize:** Review lead performance, filters, pricing, geographic targeting, emails, calls, and other account settings to help clients get the most out of the SmartFinancial platform.
* **Drive Results:** Help customers improve key performance indicators such as cost per acquisition, close rate, lead quality, return on investment, and overall account performance.
* **Retain:** Build trusted customer relationships and proactively identify issues that could impact customer satisfaction, utilization, or retention.
* **Own It:** Serve as a reliable point of contact for your assigned customers, providing consistent communication and helping them achieve their business goals.
* **Solve:** Address customer questions, objections, concerns, and ad\-related complaints using established Customer Success processes and protocols.
* **Excel:** Deliver a best\-in\-class customer experience while consistently achieving the activity, retention, talk\-time, and account\-growth goals associated with the role.

  

**Requirements** **What We’re Looking For**

* **1–2\+ years of experience** in customer service, customer success, sales, account management, or a related client\-facing role preferred.
* Proven ability to meet and exceed **KPIs, activity goals, sales targets, or other performance metrics**.
* Experience working with **insurance agencies, insurance technology, lead generation, or marketplace businesses** is highly valued.
* Experience with **high\-volume calling** and comfort communicating with customers regularly.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and clearly communicate solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to identify opportunities to improve customer performance.
* Highly motivated, **coachable, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment**.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to effectively manage a large book of customer accounts.
* Basic computer proficiency and the ability to quickly learn and utilize new software and technology.
* Must be available for **full\-time, in\-office work**. (6am\-3pm) PST

  

**Benefits** **Why You’ll Love It Here**

* **Base Salary: $70,034**
* **Career Growth:** Start your career as a CSM1 with a clear path toward **CSM2 and Strategic CSM** opportunities for high performers.
* **Training \& Development:** Receive extensive product training, coaching, role\-play opportunities, and ongoing development to help you become an exceptional Customer Success professional.
* **Performance\-Driven:** Your success is measurable. You'll have clear goals and KPIs that allow you to understand exactly what success looks like and how you can continue to grow.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** 401k with company match, along with company\-sponsored health, dental, and life insurance plans.
* **Employee Referral Bonus:** Help us grow our team and earn additional rewards through our employee referral program.
* **World\-Class Culture:** We believe our people and culture are what make SmartFinancial special.


We’d especially like to highlight our **World Class Culture**, which our employees say is the best thing about working at SmartFinancial. We have great SLACK channels for work and play, which keep you connected with your fellow employees throughout the day. Not to mention our top\-notch company events (like our Summer Beach Party with open bar, chili cook\-off, annual holiday yacht party, fun office potlucks and more) that will keep you asking when the next event is.


We also have Penny, our company mascot. Like swag themed after a pink pig wearing glasses? Just. You. Wait.


Join SmartFinancial and become a key player in helping insurance agencies grow their businesses. If you're motivated by relationships, results, and career growth, **apply now and let's achieve success together!**

**Evening Kitchen Operations CoordinatorPosition Summary**

The Kitchen Operations Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day production and fulfillment operations of the company’s kitchen, which produces in\-house food products for two retail store locations and specialty catering. This is not a chef or cooking position.

The primary focus of the role is coordinating purchase orders from the retail stores, supporting the kitchen production team, ensuring products are properly labeled and packaged, maintaining quality and accuracy standards, and helping ensure completed products are ready for timely delivery to each store.

The Kitchen Operations Coordinator serves as an important link between the retail stores and kitchen production team, helping ensure that orders are accurately communicated, produced, packaged, labeled, and delivered according to company standards.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Receive, review, and organize purchase orders and product requests from the company’s retail store locations to prepare for delivery.
* Communicate production needs and priorities to the kitchen production team.
* Track orders through the production process and help ensure products are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Coordinate the preparation of completed products for distribution to retail locations.
* Accurately label finished food products in accordance with company procedures and applicable labeling requirements.
* Verify product labels for accuracy, including product identification, dates, quantities, and other required information.
* Perform quality\-control checks on finished products, packaging, labeling, and order quantities before products leave the kitchen.
* Package and prepare products for delivery or retail distribution as needed.
* Compare completed orders against purchase orders to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain organized records related to orders, production, labeling, and fulfillment as required.
* Communicate shortages, production issues, quality concerns, or order discrepancies to appropriate management.
* Help maintain an organized and efficient production and fulfillment workflow.
* Coordinate with retail store employees regarding order status, changes, shortages, or other fulfillment needs.
* Transport products, supplies, or other company materials between the kitchen and retail locations as needed.
* Safely operate a company vehicle or authorized vehicle when driving is required.
* Follow company food\-safety, sanitation, quality\-control, workplace\-safety, and operational procedures.
* Maintain clean and organized packaging, labeling, storage, and work areas.
* Assist with inventory counts, supply organization, receiving, and other kitchen operations activities as needed.
* Provide hands\-on operational support to the kitchen production team as needed, excluding duties requiring a chef or specialized culinary role.
* Receive incoming deliveries.
* Perform other related duties as assigned based on operational needs.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in food production, manufacturing, fulfillment, retail operations, inventory, warehouse operations, or a similar environment preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to accurately quality control purchase orders, labels, quantities, and product information.
* Ability to prioritize multiple orders and communicate effectively with both kitchen and retail teams.
* Dependable and able to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced food\-production environment.
* Basic computer, email, and data\-entry skills.
* Ability to follow established food\-safety, quality\-control, and operational procedures.
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record required as driving is an essential function of the position.
* Bi\-lingual, English/Spanish is required.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical requirements described below are representative of those necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Regularly stand and walk for extended periods.
* Frequently use hands for labeling, packaging, handling products, and performing other operational tasks.
* Regularly reach, bend, stoop, and move throughout kitchen, storage, and production areas.
* Lift, carry, push, and/or move products, boxes, supplies, and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Work in and around a commercial food\-production environment, which may include exposure to hot and cold temperatures, refrigeration areas, food products, cleaning products, and production equipment.
* Safely enter and exit a vehicle and load or unload products when performing delivery duties.

This position primarily works within a commercial kitchen/food\-production environment and regularly interacts with kitchen production employees, retail store personnel, and management. **Job Title: ASLA Coordinator**

**HOW THIS ROLE SUPPORTS THE MISSION**

EOYDC’s After School Leadership Academy (ASLA) provides resources for K\-5 students to develop in the areas of academics, leadership, and character. Under the direction of the ASLA Manager, the ASLA Coordinator is responsible for coordinating all aspects of the ASLA program. These duties include, but are not limited to, supporting the design of ASLA curriculum, implementing lesson plans, training and managing the ASLA Youth Leader interns, assessing program outcomes, and building/maintaining relationships with participants, families, and partner schools.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

This role will collaborate across the organization, sometimes as the lead of a project and sometimes as support. The person in this role will be responsible for ensuring the success of the following:

* Development and facilitation of lessons, activities, field trips, and events that are consistent with the mission of the program for students in grades K\-5
* Creation and adjustment of weekly program schedule in consideration of partner school schedules and organization\-wide events
* ASLA student engagement
* Provide instruction based on engaging lesson plans developed to strengthen academic performance, enhance leadership skills, and develop character
* Supervise children and promote safety and respect amongst all participants
* Identify student academic and behavioral strengths and challenges, and work with the ASLA Manager and team to create appropriate plan to address their unique needs
* Work closely with students’ teachers and families to promote academic success
* Provide students with direct support to promote emotional/psychological health and development
* Establish two way communication channels to facilitate ongoing engagement with participants’ parents, guardians, and educators

**WHO YOU WILL WORK CLOSELY WITH**

This role is part of the ASLA Team, which works directly with EOYDC’s K\-5 students. Specifically, the following people will work directly with you to support your work:

* Manager: ASLA Manager
* Your manager will help guide your work and be an advocate for you amongst senior leadership. They will also, with input from the Chief Program Officer, help you set the objectives and vision for the various activities that you will lead.
* Team Members: ASLA Coaches and Youth Leaders
* The Youth Leaders will work directly with the students on a daily basis and will provide you support by leading or supporting the activities that you plan
* The Coaches will support you as an additional layer of accountability for the youth leaders and will also provide support for large events

**WHO \& WHAT YOU WILL SUPPORT**

EOYDC’s collaborative culture means that everyone supports one another in achieving the organization’s goals. These are some of the ways you will support work that is led by others on the team:

* The ASLA Manager in:
* Identifying opportunities for program and process improvement
* Providing Intern and Staff support
* Provide supervision, guidance, resources, and feedback to ASLA Coaches and Youth Leaders
* Assist with the regular training ASLA Youth Leaders receiving in order to facilitate growth in the areas of classroom management, tutoring/instruction, leadership, early childhood development, parent engagement, and other key success factors
* Reinforce program policies and procedures through role modeling, coaching, and performance management
* Assessment \& Reporting

**PROGRAM DESCRIPTION:**

The Health and Wellness Division supports Contra Costa County residents aged 60 and older by offering companionship, education, and access to key services. Programs include friendly visits or phone check\-in calls, exercise classes, nutrition education, and CalAIM Community Health Worker (CHW) services. Its mission is to enrich the well\-being of older adults by fostering connection, providing essential resources, and encouraging active, healthy living.

**SCOPE OF WORK:**

The CalAIM Program Specialist is responsible for coordinating and tracking the day\-to\-day administrative and operational workflows that support the successful delivery, documentation of Friendly Programs, and claims processing of CalAIM Community Health Worker (CHW) services.

This position serves as a key point of coordination between the Friendly Services and CalAIM teams. The specialist ensures that referrals, eligibility verification, authorizations, claims, reporting, and client transitions and discharges are completed accurately, promptly, and in compliance with program requirements.

In addition to completing assigned tasks, the specialist is responsible for maintaining accurate data entry, preparing monthly GetCare reports, actively monitoring workflows, following up on outstanding issues, documenting actions taken, and ensuring all items are resolved and closed. Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow\-through to ensure that no critical task falls through the cracks. This position is a 40\-hour\-per\-week position and reports to the Health \& Wellness Senior Manager.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage MCP (Managed Care Plans) referrals, track status, and follow up on missing information to ensure timely service initiation.
* Verify eligibility and maintain accurate service documentation to support compliance and billing requirements.
* Coordinate billing activities, reconcile claims and payments, and address denials, discrepancies, and related issues.
* Prepare, review, and submit MCPreports and compliance documentation, ensuring data accuracy and timeliness.
* Track clinical approvals, client transitions, and discharges to ensure complete and compliant documentation.
* Identify and resolve data, authorization, claims, and reporting issues that impact program operations.
* Maintain tracking systems and work queues, ensuring timely follow\-up, documentation, and closure of all assigned tasks.
* Evaluate clients’ needs and make referrals using agency programs and community resources as needed.
* Participate in first client visits for the Friendly Visitors program in Walnut Creek and Concord areas.
* Manage Special Project as needed

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 2\+ years of experience in healthcare administration, care coordination, managed care, billing, or healthcare operations.
* Experience with CalAIM, CHW, Medi\-Cal, MCPs, claims, eligibility, or healthcare reporting preferred.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities with a high level of accuracy.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of healthcare privacy and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with external partners while managing multiple priorities.
* Proficient with spreadsheets, CaseWorthy, GetCare, and Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.

* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.
* Valid California driver’s license, proof of insurance, reliable transportation, and smartphone required.
* Must pass a background check.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.



At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.



A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist to join our and help bring influencer campaigns to life. This is an execution\-focused role built for someone who is highly organized, creator\-savvy, and eager to get hands\-on experience across all facets of influencer marketing — from day\-to\-day campaign coordination to supporting live events on the ground.



You'll work closely with senior team members to support a roster of creators, keep campaigns running on time, and be a key point of contact for influencers throughout their partnership journey. If you love being in the mix, thrive in fast\-paced environments, and take pride in getting the details right, this role is for you.


**You will****:**
-----------------


**Campaign Support**


* Assist in the end\-to\-end execution of influencer campaigns — supporting briefing, content review, posting coordination, and performance tracking
* Manage campaign timelines and deliverable trackers, flagging risks and keeping all parties aligned
* Partner with internal teams to draft creator briefs, talking points, and campaign recaps under the direction of senior team members
* Coordinate with internal teams (creative, legal, social, events) to ensure influencer content is on\-brand and delivered on schedule
* Pull and compile performance data from influencer platforms and internal dashboards to support weekly and campaign\-level reporting


**Event Support**


* Serve as an on\-the\-ground point of contact for influencers at live events — managing logistics, schedules, and real\-time needs
* Help coordinate influencer travel, accommodations, and event\-day itineraries in partnership with the events and operations teams
* Support event activations from pre\-production through wrap, ensuring creator experience is smooth and on\-brand
* Assist in capturing content moments and documentation at events for post\-event recaps and learnings


**Relationship Management**


* Act as a day\-to\-day contact for a defined roster of creators and their management teams, building trust and maintaining positive ongoing relationships
* Track creator deliverables, communicate deadlines, and follow up to keep partnerships on schedule
* Help onboard new influencers into the program — sending contracts, answering questions, and walking partners through the process
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records in the influencer CRM, including contact info, campaign history, and relationship notes
* Monitor creator content, community sentiment, and platform activity to surface relevant updates to the team

**You have:**
-------------


* 3\-4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator relations, talent management, social media, or a closely related field
* A genuine understanding of the creator landscape — you follow creators, know the platforms, and can speak fluently about content trends
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball


**You are:**


* Clear, professional communicator — comfortable drafting emails to creators and their reps, and working cross\-functionally with internal teams
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can shift and no two days look the same
* Detail\-oriented and proactive — you spot what needs to happen next and take initiative to make it happen
* Familiar with influencer platforms, social media analytics tools, or creator CRM systems is a plus

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Experience supporting live events or experiential marketing activations
* Exposure to influencer contracting, gifting programs, or affiliate/commission structures
* Background in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech with knowledge of UGC creator communities
* Proficiency in Google Suite and knowledge of creator focused tools like Tubular, CreatorIQ, etc


Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).



Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.



For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H\-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.description:
**About Campfire**  

Campfire is a next\-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid\-market finance teams. We’re building the future of ERP by replacing outdated systems and manual accounting processes with an AI\-native platform that helps finance teams move faster and operate more efficiently.  

  

**About the role**


You'll run Campfire's social presence and turn it into a real channel: the company voice on LinkedIn and YouTube, a credible presence in the Reddit communities where our buyers ask questions, and the executive and employee voices that make a B2B brand feel human. You'll own strategy, programming, community management and reporting, working closely with our content, video and influencer teams.

**What you'll do**

* Own the social strategy and content calendar across LinkedIn, YouTube and Reddit, with channel goals tied to reach, engagement, community growth and assisted pipeline.
* Program and publish daily: write posts, adapt video with the Content / Storytelling team, and run YouTube channel operations (titles, thumbnails, playlists, Shorts, community posts).
* Build Campfire's Reddit approach with the SEO \& AEO Manager: find the right communities, participate transparently and helpfully rather than promotionally, and track how that presence shows up in AI answers.
* Run executive and employee social programs: ghostwriting and coaching for founders and leaders, employee advocacy, and launch amplification.
* Own community management and social listening: respond, escalate, and route insights to Product, Product Marketing and Support.
* Partner with Influencer Marketing on creator amplification and with Paid Media on organic\-to\-paid handoffs (boosting, thought\-leader ads).
* Report monthly on channel performance and what we learned, and test formats constantly.

**What you'll bring**

* 6\+ years managing B2B social for a company or brand, with proof you've grown a channel and an audience.
* Excellent short\-form writing and a sharp eye for what works on LinkedIn, YouTube and Reddit specifically; you know these are three different cultures.
* Hands\-on YouTube channel management (analytics, packaging, Shorts).
* Reddit fluency: you understand subreddit norms and moderation, and how to build credibility without getting the brand banned.
* Comfort working with video (briefing, light editing, captions) and with scheduling and listening tools.
* Judgment and speed; you can handle a live moment or a tricky thread without escalating everything.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building executive or founder personal brands.
* Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for on\-brand templates.
* An understanding of how social and community content influences AI\-answer visibility.

**What success looks like in 30 days**

* Channels and audience audited; social strategy, cadence and KPI framework published.
* Executive social program live with at least two leaders.
* Reddit playbook agreed with SEO \& AEO and active participation under way.

We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



This role is ideal for someone with hands\-on B2B prospecting experience who can combine thoughtful outbound outreach with strong follow\-up and qualification of inbound demand.



As a BDR, you will play a front\-line role in DigitalOcean's growth. You will research and prioritize accounts, build relevant prospecting hypotheses, create curated outreach, engage technical buyers, and qualify new customers who are building and scaling on cloud infrastructure.

As a Business Development Representative for the USA, you will own top\-of\-funnel pipeline generation across your assigned territory, identifying and qualifying new business opportunities and handing off Sales\-Qualified Leads and Deals (SQLs) to our Account Executive team. jobs.description:
**About Us**

This position is employed by Gateway Licensing, with the employee working full\-time, on\-site at iApparel Brands LLC. iApparel Brands LLC, established in 2007, is a New York–based apparel company focused on building and scaling men's, women’s, and kid’s apparel businesses. iApparel operates a portfolio of high\-velocity brands including **Dickies, Von Dutch, Perry Ellis, Southpole, and Warner Bros**. iApparel partners with major U.S. retailers to deliver trend\-right product at scale. The team is hands\-on, execution\-driven, and built for people who move quickly, take ownership, and expect results.

**Role Description**

This is a full\-time, on\-site licensing and marketing role based in Manhattan, NY, working exclusively with iApparel Brands LLC. This is an entry\-level position — we are looking for a person who knows how to drive business and keep things moving. You will own and manage relationships internally and externally with licensors and licensees. The right candidate has experience in marketing, and experience in licensing is a strong plus. You should be comfortable managing multiple projects at the same time, reacting quickly to tasks, and pushing your items forward in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment. This is a highly visible role with real responsibility, on a lean, execution\-driven team.

**Objectives**

* Serve as a key point of contact for licensing activity across iApparel Brands LLC's portfolio — driving internal movement, tracking, reporting, and submissions from start to finish.
* Build and manage relationships with external licensing partners (Licensors and Licensees), representing iApparel Brands LLC with professionalism and responsiveness.
* Support brand marketing efforts, including influencer and talent coordination, to help execute high\-velocity, trend\-right go\-to\-market plans.
* Create, maintain, and continuously improve Licensing SOPs to keep a lean, execution\-driven team moving efficiently.

**Reports To**

* Reports to Manager.
* Partners and communicates with President and Owner.

**Daily Activities**

· *As a Licensee Coordinator — manages all company\-licensed brands in partnership with Manager:*

* Submit all required reporting requests on time for Licensors (Placements, Forecasts, Finance, etc.).
* Partners with Sales and Design teams to understand current activities and timelines.
* Partners with Design team on all submissions and artwork requests.

* Assists Operations/Finance in quarterly royalty reporting and payment schedules.

· *As a Licensor Coordinator — manages the family brands' licensing in partnership with Manager:*

* Delivers regular communications and updates to current Licensees.

* Updates regularly all Brand PowerPoints and Brand guidelines with new activities and visuals.
* Partners with Operations/Finance to secure all Licensee reports, royalties, and payments.
* Requests and collects semi\-annual forecasts from licensees using the forecast template.
* Schedules and sets agendas for all quarterly and semi\-annual meetings with Licensees.
* Schedules and sets agendas for all quarterly and semi\-annual internal Licensing review meetings with key company members.

*As a Marketing Coordinator — manages social media platforms and websites and helps identify and execute new marketing opportunities:*

* Builds and manages brands' social media calendars.
* Manages and updates brands' websites and brand decks.
* Identifies and coordinates influencer and talent partnerships in support of brand marketing initiatives.

* Identifies new possible marketing opportunities and presents to Manager.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Experience in marketing required; experience in licensing is a strong plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Ability to Commute:

jobs.title: Private Events Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Reports to:**

General Manager (dotted line coordination with Maître'd and Chef)

**Employment type:**

Part\-time — Hourly, non\-exempt, plus commission

**Schedule:**

Standard business hours, with regular evening and weekend availability required for client site tours and to attend events in progress

**Scope:**

Maxwell Alley private events (recommended initial scope — see note at end of document)

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Maxwell Alley is seeking a Private Events Sales Coordinator to own the full sales cycle for our private dining and event space — from first inquiry through signed contract — and to actively grow our events business through outbound outreach. This person is the primary point of contact for prospective event hosts during the decision\-making and booking process, with a hand off to our on\-site events team (Maître'd and General Manager) once a contract is signed. He or she remains financially and administratively responsible for the event through final settlement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Lead Management \& Sales**

* Respond promptly to all incoming private event inquiries — website intake form, email, phone, and other sources — with an acknowledgement the same business day, and a full response/quote within 36 hours.
* Maintain a single, up\-to\-date pipeline of every lead from first contact through signed contract, using Tripleseat software.
* Provide prospective hosts with everything needed to make a decision: availability, pricing, menu options, room capacity, layout possibilities, and decor/rental options.
* Prepare and send proposals, customized menu packages, and floor plans; recommend add\-ons (premium bar packages, florals, AV/entertainment, custom cakes, late\-night extensions) to grow average event value.
* Follow up consistently on open leads through a defined cadence until they convert or are closed out.
* Secure deposits and signed BEOs/contracts, and book confirmed events in Resy.

**Business Development / Outreach**

* Proactively prospect and generate new (“cold”) event business through targeted outreach — cold calling/emailing, list\-building (corporate offices, law firms, nonprofits, wedding and event planners), networking events, and referral relationships with planners and corporate concierges.
* Build and maintain a preferred\-vendor list (florists, bands/DJs, photographers, rental companies) for client referrals.

**Client Management**

* Meet prospective clients on\-site as part of their decision\-making process, including evenings/weekends as needed.
* Work along side the restaurant’s Maître’d to address client questions on room layout, decor, and other event logistics throughout the planning process.
* Adjust the BEO as event details change, keeping all stakeholders current.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Participate in regular pre\-event meetings with the on\-site events team (GM, Maître'd, Chef, Bar Manager) to review upcoming events and confirm details.
* Hand off confirmed events cleanly to the on\-site team, ensuring nothing is lost in translation.

**Performance Monitoring \& Optimization**

* On an ongoing basis, monitor conversion rates, ease and success of event execution, and other relevant business metrics.
* Collaborate with the GM to adjust event parameters (pricing, packages, minimums, policies, etc.) as needed to keep offerings competitive and attractive to prospective hosts while remaining efficient for restaurant operations.

**Financial \& Administrative**

* Collect deposits and progress/final payments per the contract schedule.
* Ensure signed contracts include cancellation/postponement terms, deposit schedule, and certificate\-of\-insurance requirements for any outside vendors.
* Close out each event financially: final invoicing, settling the bill, and return of deposit where applicable.

**Post\-Event**

* Solicit post\-event feedback from hosts.
* Flag repeat\-booking opportunities (annual corporate holiday parties, recurring galas, etc.) and re\-engage past clients on a proactive schedule.
* Track and report on conversion rate, booked revenue, and pipeline status on a regular (e.g., weekly) basis.

**COMPENSATION**

* **Base hourly rate:** $20–$24/hour.
* **Commission basis: Share of Event Admin Fee collected.**  Warm leads (inbound via website, email, phone, or other unsolicited contact): 33% of Event Admin Fee collected. Cold leads (sourced through this person's own outreach/prospecting): 67% of Event Admin Fee collected
* **Definition of “cold”:** a lead with no prior inbound contact or marketing touch, directly attributable to this person's own prospecting (cold call/email, networking, referral relationships)

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Prior experience in restaurant, catering, or event planning/sales strongly preferred. If none, other hospitality experience is required.
* Familiarity with Tripleseat or comparable event booking/CRM software.
* Strong math skills; comfortable calculating pricing, deposits, and payment schedules accurately.
* Proficient with Excel/spreadsheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — proposals and client correspondence are a core part of the job.
* Fluent English language skills required.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple events at different stages of planning simultaneously.
* Sales\-driven, client\-facing personality with strong follow\-through.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person
