jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Golden Steer is a digitally native food brand and restaurant company. We are anchored by the original Golden Steer Steakhouse in Las Vegas, a true dining institution as the oldest steakhouse in the city. What started as a single location restaurant has grown into two locations and a high growth eCommerce business where we ship our seasonings nationwide. We're scaling across channels, products, and geographies and we're building the team to match.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Golden Steer is hiring a Marketing Coordinator to be the operating engine behind marketing across all three of our businesses: our seasonings eCommerce line, Golden Steer Las Vegas, and Golden Steer New York. This is the person who turns the plan into shipped work. You will be the operational back bone, owning the marketing calendar, executing email, coordinating creative across paid and organic, while supporting restaurant marketing for both restaurants, and keeping every marketing initiative on schedule across three brands at once.

This is a senior coordinator seat. We are hiring someone who has already held this job, knows how the pieces fit, and is ready for the next rung. You will report to our Director of Organic Marketing. We are a small team and you’ll have an opportunity to work on several exciting projects that will set you up to have a big creative voice and eventually drive the direction of day to day marketing.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own one marketing calendar across all three brands, covering promos, product launches, restaurant events, and seasonal peak moments, with owners, dates, and dependencies the whole team can trust.
* Email execution for eCommerce \& Steakhouse. Sometimes that will require building one off emails, planning the schedule for sending. We have an email partner so the emphasis will be more on reporting back on what performed and what you would change.
* Creative operations. Write and route briefs, traffic assets into paid and organic, hold naming conventions in Motion and Meta Ads Manager, and work with our Content Coordinator to keep the asset library clean enough that anyone can find the right file in under a minute.
* Organic social coordination under the Director of Organic Marketing. Own the Social calendar across brands, coordinate posts with creative partners, schedule and publish, and keep community response times tight.
* Project\-manage campaigns and launches from brief through go\-live and post\-mortem. Build timelines, coordinate stakeholders, track deliverables, proactively flag roadblocks, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Paid media support. Keep trafficking, tagging, and QA airtight, pull weekly performance numbers, and flag what needs attention before it turns into a problem.
* Restaurant marketing for Las Vegas and New York. Local partnerships, reservations platforms, events, in\-restaurant collateral, and whatever the GMs need to drive covers.
* PR and influencer logistics. Press requests, sample sends, hosted visits, and content collaborations, coordinated end to end.
* Weekly reporting. Pull the numbers, put them in a consistent format every week, and surface the three things worth acting on.
* Post\-mortems. Every promo gets closed out with what we spent, what we made, and what we do differently next time.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**We're prioritizing skills in this order:**

* Execution (must be expert). You get things done, on time, without being chased. You take an ambiguous priority, break it into steps, and close it out. This is the most important thing.
* Organization (must be excellent). Your calendars, trackers, and files are clean and current. Nothing falls through, and the team can see status without asking you for it.
* Marketing judgment (must be capable, owned expertise). You understand why a campaign is built the way it is, you can read the numbers, and you have opinions. We will keep developing this with you.

**In addition, you should bring:**

* Real reps. 3 to 4 years in a marketing coordinator, marketing associate, or marketing operations role, ideally at a DTC brand, a hospitality group, or an agency serving them. You have run a calendar, sent the sends, and owned deadlines that mattered.
* Ownership without hand holding. You are given the outcome and you figure out the path.
* Comfort with numbers. AOV, ROAS, CTR, CVR, open and click rates. You can pull them, format them, and explain what moved.
* Range across brands. eCommerce, a Las Vegas institution, and a new New York restaurant have different customers and different needs. You can hold all three in your head in the same week.
* A genuine love of food and hospitality. You will be working inside two restaurants and a seasonings brand, and this should excite you.
* Flexibility. Restaurants and launches do not run on a 9 to 5\. Some evenings and weekends come with the territory.

**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU...**

* Have already done this job somewhere and are ready for the promotion.
* Are the most organized person on any team you have been on, and it shows in the systems you leave behind you.
* Move fast and close loops. Nothing sits untouched in your inbox for three days.
* Would rather ask a blunt question today than surface a problem next week.
* Get real satisfaction from making other people's work land on time and land well.
* Are comfortable executing within a small team but interacting with big senior leaders across lines
* Have an appreciation for the brand. We opened in 1958, the history matters, and every asset has to feel like us.
* Understand personas. On eCommerce our customers are largely suburban Gen X, Boomer, and Silent Generation home cooks, which is a different audience from the people booking a table in New York or Las Vegas.
* Like being in the room. This role is in person in New York, with periodic travel to our Las Vegas restaurant.

**TOOLS WE USE**

* CapCut
* Canva
* Sprout Social
* Google Analytics
* Shopify
* Klaviyo
* Motion
* Slac

Help shape innovative advertising solutions that connect world\-class brands with engaged audiences across one of the industry's most dynamic media portfolios. As an Account Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in bringing campaigns to life—from strategic planning through flawless execution—while building trusted relationships that drive long\-term client success.

* Partner with clients, agencies, and internal teams to understand business objectives and develop strategic advertising solutions using Hearst Magazines' full portfolio of brands and products.

**Job Overview**

**Location: New York City \- Hybrid Role. Only candidates currently living in NY, NJ, and CT will be considered.**

Afficiency is seeking an Account Manager (NY\-Hybrid) to support and grow relationships with our distribution partners. Reporting directly to the Chief Growth Officer, this individual will play a critical role in onboarding new partners and agents, coordinating successful launches, and driving ongoing engagement and growth across Afficiency’s distribution network.

**This is a high\-activity role that requires exceptional organization, urgency, resourcefulness, and follow\-through. The Account Manager must be able to manage numerous partner needs and workstreams simultaneously while using AI, automation, and other productivity tools to create a scalable and consistently high\-quality partner experience.**

The successful candidate will be highly solutions\-oriented and proactive in identifying impediments to success, whether within their own responsibilities or across agent onboarding, contracting, and partner launch processes. This person will work collaboratively with internal teams to understand root causes, develop practical solutions, and continually improve operational performance and the partner and agent experience.

Success in this role means more than completing assigned tasks. The Account Manager is expected to identify what may prevent partners and agents from succeeding, take ownership of moving issues forward, and work across the organization to develop solutions that improve onboarding speed, contracting efficiency, partner performance, and the overall distribution experience.

**Responsibilities**

**Partner and Agent Onboarding**

Lead onboarding activities for new distribution partners, ensuring a seamless and well\-organized launch experience.

Support the onboarding and contracting of agencies, agents, and other distribution partners, helping ensure requirements are completed accurately and efficiently.

Serve as a primary point of contact for partners and agents throughout the onboarding and implementation process.

Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Growth, Operations, Licensing and Contracting, Compliance, Product, and Technology to drive successful launches.

Develop and maintain onboarding plans, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and success metrics for each partner.

Monitor onboarding and contracting activity, identify incomplete requirements or process bottlenecks, and proactively drive outstanding items toward resolution.

Anticipate potential impediments to onboarding, contracting, integration, or launch and address them before they affect timelines or the partner experience.

Identify recurring points of friction and work with the appropriate teams to implement practical, scalable solutions.

**Account Management and Partner Success**

Build trusted relationships with distribution partners and serve as their primary day\-to\-day contact.

Manage a high volume of partner and agent communications, requests, meetings, deliverables, and follow\-up activities.

Maintain a clear understanding of each partner’s priorities, performance, open items, impediments, and growth opportunities.

Conduct regular business reviews and identify opportunities to increase sales, engagement, and partner satisfaction.

Monitor key performance indicators and provide partners and internal stakeholders with actionable insights and recommendations.

Proactively identify issues that could affect partner or agent success and coordinate the appropriate internal resources to resolve them.

Support partner retention and expansion by identifying unmet needs and opportunities to deepen the relationship.

**Solutions Development and Continuous Improvement**

Proactively identify impediments that could prevent the Account Manager, an agent, or a distribution partner from achieving a successful outcome.

Investigate the root causes of delays, errors, recurring questions, or underperformance rather than addressing only the immediate symptoms.

Bring forward thoughtful recommendations and potential solutions rather than simply escalating problems.

Work collaboratively with internal teams to design and implement improvements to processes, technology, communication, documentation, and training.

Look for patterns across partner and agent experiences and use those insights to identify broader improvement opportunities.

Develop practical, scalable solutions that improve onboarding speed, contracting efficiency, data quality, partner responsiveness, and overall performance.

Monitor the effectiveness of process improvements and refine solutions based on performance data and stakeholder feedback.

**Activity Management and Process Optimization**

Manage numerous accounts, projects, agent onboarding cases, contracting activities, and partner workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail.

Maintain clear visibility into account activity, ownership, deadlines, dependencies, impediments, and next steps.

Establish effective systems for prioritizing work, documenting decisions, tracking commitments, and ensuring timely follow\-through.

Develop scalable processes, templates, workflows, and reporting practices that enable Afficiency to support a growing partner and agent base.

Use AI, automation, CRM, and productivity tools to improve workflow efficiency, prepare communications, summarize meetings, organize information, maintain documentation, and identify required follow\-up.

Apply sound judgment when using AI tools, including reviewing outputs for accuracy, protecting confidential information, and complying with company policies.

Identify repetitive or manual activities that can be standardized, automated, or completed more efficiently.

Use reporting and operational data to identify delays, trends, capacity constraints, and opportunities for improvement.

**Sales Enablement and Business Growth**

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.


At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.


This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------



Responsible for Regional Enterprise sales account development within an established geographic territory for a complex suite of services and robust product sets to drive sales, increase brand awareness, and grow a specific territory.


**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* Providing accurate and detailed weekly forecast funnel of identified and proposed opportunities in order to meet or exceed sales quota requirements
* Responsible for developing Regional Enterprise sales in the designated target market(s) by identifying new sales opportunities with prospective enterprise customers headquartered in the region by cold calling, premise visits, networking, lead generation, proposal submission, and customer appointments.
* Effective relationship\-building internally through cross\-functional collaboration and problem\-solving with partners such as Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Solutions/Technology experts, Sales Support, Service Delivery
* Identifies, bids on, negotiates, and closes new sales opportunities in order to meet and exceed established sales and revenue quotas. Provides comprehensive account plans and strategies to win new business from existing accounts.
* Providing input to sales management about trends and changes taking place within the customer’s organization and making recommendations about future courses of action necessary of the company towards improving its position with the customer.
* Leveraging strategic client relationships and external presence to achieve Lumen’s strategic imperatives
* Leveraging your external network to identify and recruit high performing talent to the team and builds internal relationships with other leaders to provide win\-win career opportunities to Lumen employees
* Requires at least 50% or more of time conducting sales activities outside of the office.
**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and experience
* Demonstrated strong communication, written, and formal presentation skills as well as proficiency in selling to the close.
* Proficiency in MS Office Products: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Strong business acumen and expert knowledge of Lumen’s products, services, and solutions
* Experience with Salesforce.com preferred
**Compensation**
----------------

May provide training of and/or supervision to subordinate staff, and maintains positive public relations presence within the community.

Equivalency Program; and,

jobs.title: Associate Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Neptune Technology Group Inc.** is a technology company serving water utilities across North America. Since 1892, we have continually focused on the evolving needs of water utilities — revenue optimization, operational efficiencies, and improved customer service. With our portfolio of smart water meters, data collection systems and software, we make data actionable for our customers — so they can remain focused on *the business of water*. For additional information, please visit the company website at www.neptunetg.com (http://www.neptunetg.com/).

  


**Project Coordinator**


**Position Summary**


* Support the Project/Program Manager in planning, scheduling, and tracking tasks and deliverables across one or more concurrent projects.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project documentation, including project plans, status reports, meeting minutes, and action item logs.
* Coordinate and schedule project meetings with stakeholders, ensuring agendas, materials, and follow\-up notes are distributed in a timely manner.
* Track project risks, issues, and action items, following up with owners to help ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain project management tools (e.g., Jira, SharePoint, Smartsheet) to keep task status, timelines, and dependencies current.
* Prepare status reports, dashboards, and presentation materials summarizing project progress for leadership and stakeholders.
* Support onboarding of new team members and vendors to project processes, tools, and PMO standards.
* Facilitate communication and information flow between technical and non\-technical teams involved in a project.
* Help enforce PMO governance, templates, and standard processes across assigned projects.
* Perform other administrative and coordination duties as assigned by the Project/Program Manager or PMO leadership.

  


**Skills:**


* **Organizational skills** — Tracking multiple tasks, deadlines, and deliverables across projects without letting details slip. This includes maintaining schedules, action item lists, and document repositories in a way others can follow.
* **Communication skills** — Clearly conveying updates, status reports, and requests to project managers, team members, and stakeholders, both in writing (emails, meeting notes) and verbally (status meetings, check\-ins).
* **Basic project management tool proficiency** — Comfort with tools like Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, or Asana for tracking tasks, timelines, and dependencies, since coordinators are often the ones keeping these systems updated day to day.
* **Attention to detail** — Catching inconsistencies in schedules, budgets, or documentation before they become bigger problems; accuracy matters a lot at this level since coordinators often handle the granular tracking that PMs rely on.
* **Problem\-solving and adaptability** — Handling shifting priorities, scheduling conflicts, or last\-minute changes calmly, and knowing when to escalate an issue versus resolving it directly.

  


**Requirements**


**Education:** Typically requires an associates or bachelor's degree (or international equivalent)


**Experience:** 0–2 years of relevant experience in project coordination, administrative support, or a related discipline.

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or Confluence.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

  


**Location:** Duluth, GA.



Neptune Technology Group Inc. does not sponsor U.S. work authorizations for this position, including H\-1B, O\-1 and TN. Neptune also does not sponsor individuals in F\-1 status for this role.

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator-Manufacturing
jobs.description:
**Purchasing Coordinator – Manufacturing**

Starflex Fabrication is seeking a dependable, organized, and proactive Purchasing Coordinator to manage purchasing activities supporting our manufacturing operation.

This position will be responsible for the procurement of all materials, components, supplies, and consumables required to keep production running. The ideal candidate understands that purchasing in a manufacturing environment is more than placing purchase orders—it requires monitoring material requirements, maintaining supplier relationships, tracking deliveries, controlling costs, and communicating potential shortages before they impact production.

Experience in sheet metal fabrication or a similar manufacturing environment is a strong plus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day purchasing activities for the facility, including:
* Sheet metal and plate
* Structural steel, tubing, angle, channel, and other raw materials
* Hardware and fasteners
* Welding supplies and consumables
* Powder coating and finishing supplies
* Shop supplies, tooling, and production consumables
* Safety and maintenance supplies
* Most general office supplies
* Review production requirements and MRP data to identify material and purchasing needs.
* Create, issue, and maintain purchase orders.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure materials arrive when required.
* Communicate material shortages, delivery delays, back orders, and other supply concerns before they affect production.
* Obtain and compare supplier quotations for pricing, availability, lead time, and freight.
* Collaborate with suppliers to maintain competitive pricing and reliable delivery performance.
* Coordinate purchasing requirements with Operations, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Accounting.
* Verify purchased materials and components meet required specifications, quantities, and revisions.
* Assist with resolving receiving discrepancies, incorrect shipments, damaged material, and supplier quality issues.
* Maintain accurate purchasing information, supplier records, pricing, and lead times within the MRP system.
* Monitor inventory levels of commonly used production supplies and consumables.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, improved lead times, supplier consolidation, and inventory reduction.
* Support supplier evaluation and purchasing documentation requirements associated with Starflex Fabrication's ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System.

**Qualifications**

* Previous purchasing, procurement, buyer, or material planning experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems required.
* Experience with ProfitFab is highly preferred.
* Sheet metal fabrication, metalworking, or structural fabrication experience is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with purchasing carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, structural materials, hardware, and manufacturing consumables is preferred.
* Ability to read and understand purchase requirements, part numbers, material specifications, quantities, and basic manufacturing documentation.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open purchase orders and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong supplier communication and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable obtaining competitive quotations and negotiating pricing, lead times, freight, and delivery requirements.
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and general computer applications.
* Must be proactive and able to identify potential shortages or supply issues before they disrupt production.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

**What We Offer**

* Full\-time, hourly position
* 4\-day regular workweek: Monday through Thursday
* Overtime on Friday as needed
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance paid 100% by the company
* Life insurance paid 100% by the company
* Compensation based on experience

**About the Position**

This is a hands\-on purchasing position supporting a fast\-paced fabrication environment. The Purchasing Coordinator will have direct responsibility for ensuring the materials and supplies needed by Production are available when required.

Success in this position requires someone who takes ownership of purchasing requirements, follows open orders through delivery, communicates problems early, and understands how purchasing decisions directly affect production schedules, customer deliveries, and overall manufacturing performance.

Experience with ProfitFab and purchasing within a sheet metal or structural fabrication environment will be given strong consideration.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $26\.50 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience using an MRP or ERP system to determine purchasing requirements and manage purchase orders?
* Which MRP/ERP systems have you used?
* Are you comfortable being responsible for purchasing across multiple categories—including production raw material, hardware, consumables, shop supplies, maintenance items, and general office supplies?
* Do you have experience working in a sheet metal fabrication, structural fabrication, metalworking, or similar manufacturing environment?

Experience:

* Purchasing: 3 years (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* College Park, GA 30349 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Field Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented **Field Operations Coordinator** to support our eviction services team. This role is central to field operations, serving as the primary link among internal teams, field crews, and clients to ensure seamless service execution.

  

As the company continues to expand into new markets, the Field Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency, service quality, and client satisfaction. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with proven logistics expertise and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environment. This position requires a hands\-on approach to scheduling, dispatching, and real\-time problem\-solving to ensure professional and timely field execution.

 **Key Responsibilities**


* Coordinate, schedule, and dispatch labor crews for eviction services across multiple locations
* Act as the primary point of contact for field crews, property managers, and clients during active job windows
* Confirm job schedules with labor teams and clients, ensuring clear and timely communication
* Monitor job progress, track completion status, and collect required reports and photographs
* Proactively troubleshoot and resolve field issues such as delays, access challenges, or crew availability concerns
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records related to job activity, labor hours, and service outcomes
* Communicate professionally via phone and email to confirm logistics, respond to inquiries, and provide status updates
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment between operations, billing, and client expectations
* Support post\-job activities, including documentation, reporting, and follow\-up coordination


**Qualifications**


* Prior experience in field operations coordination, dispatching, logistics, or operations support; experience in eviction or property services is a plus
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally in high\-pressure situations
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Proficiency with scheduling or dispatch software and general comfort with technology
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and adapt quickly to changing priorities
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, digital calendars, and shared task management tools
* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to professionalism and service excellence

jobs.title: Key Account Manager- The Home Depot
jobs.description:
**Job ID:** 18112

**Location: Atlanta, GA**

 **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high\-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day.

 **Job Summary:**


The Key Account Manager is responsible for supporting the development and execution of the omni sales plan. Successful candidates will work in collaboration with the Omni Sales Team, Sales Planning, and Supply Chain to develop sustainable growth strategies. This role will provide guidance and support in developing and achieving Newell’s strategies for assigned category. **Responsibilities:**

  

* Leads the development of specific account strategies and annual operating plans that deliver Newell Brands budget and Omni Distribution, Shelving, Merchandising, and Price expectations at the category level.
* Leads the execution of annual Innovation Summits, development and delivery of customer Joint Business Plans, and successful execution of annual Line Reviews at the category level.
* Frequently interact with customer personnel to drive the execution of the customer category plan, building strong relationships at the Merchant/Buyer level
* P\&L responsibility for business across the customer account. Must demonstrate strong financial acumen and the ability to manage all account P\&L levers including List price, sales allowances, rebates, markdowns, trade marketing spend and other customer investments (i.e., Retail Media, Customer Data) at the category level.
* Strong cross\-functional expertise in operational disciplines such as providing a monthly sales forecast and end to end supply planning with the customer. Must possess a strong understanding of customer distribution network and customer related metrics (i.e. Fill Rate, On\-Time, Vendor Lead time, In\-Stocks).
* Participates in the monthly Customer Business Review with Segment and Enterprise Leadership, highlighting risks and opportunities to annual operating plan and customer JBP.
* Participates in the monthly Segment Demand Review as a key step of the Newell S\&OP process
* Networks and builds strong relationships with key customer decision makers and key internal stakeholders.
* Externally advocates for the Newell business and internally advocates for the customer.
* Leads all facets of Talent Management (recruiting, selection, performance management, and career planning) with direct reports.
* Use data, information systems, and metrics around financial, brand, and shopper trends to maximize market share, sales, and gross margin.
* Manages trade spend/customer programs in collaboration with trade and finance to deliver \\exceed Newell annual budget and customer JBP targets
* Negotiates and manages trade funds to create customer and company value by consistently measuring and enforcing trade terms and identifying opportunities for improvement
* Works with demand planning to develop accurate sales forecasts and achieve specified levels of forecast accuracy Monitors the competitors' brands and products as well as our market share, competitor market share, and target market share to understand shopper trends and opportunities and communicating to appropriate sales, trade and brand management
* Leverages our brands and product mix to improve profitability and meet customer, shopper, and Newell Brands targets
* Leverage category development management, customer planning, commercial finance, and customer supply chain resources in the development and activation of customer category business plans.
* Analyze business trends and ideates on ways to drive the business – collaborates with cross functional team on the tactics
* Responsible for accurate sales forecast and sales attainment
* Track plan progress and conduct timely reviews with customer; make plan adjustments as necessary
* Leverage customer knowledge and consultative selling (SIERA) to create win\-win solutions for customer/category growth
* Monitors the competitors’ brands and products as well as our market share, competitor market share, and target market share to understand shopper trends and opportunities and communicating to appropriate sales, CSP and brand management
* Present plans, recommendations, initiatives to customer to gain approval
* Leverage category and consumer insights to build customer\-centric recommendations to sales growth.

  



**Key Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business or similar field required, MBA is a plus
* Minimum 5\+ years of direct and hands\-on experience in sales
* Experience working in a Consumer\-Packaged Goods (CPG), Fast\-Moving Consumer Good (FMCG) and/or consumer durables industry strongly preferred
* Ability to analyze syndicated data
* Experience working within a live trade accrual system
* High level knowledge and understanding working with Retailer POS system \& metrics
* Ability to run, comprehend and communicate report findings
* Selling experience within consumer products, preferrable across multiple brands
* Ability to operate independently given direction, and bring ideas and solutions to issues raised
* Ability to analyze and assess organizational needs and provide solutions accordingly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; must be able to present data in an organized manner to different levels of the organization
* Strong project planning, tracking \& organizing skills
* Ability to build relationships and navigate a matrixed organization

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (API / CPaaS)
jobs.description:
**Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Vonage Communications APIs:**
-------------------------------



As an emerging leader in the $10B\+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.


**Why this role matters:**
--------------------------



As an Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR), you'll be the first point of contact for potential customers, playing a crucial role in generating and qualifying new sales opportunities. Your primary goal is to identify prospects, assess their needs, and schedule meetings with the sales team to drive pipeline growth.  

This role provides tremendous career growth opportunities within Vonage. We expect our SDRs to develop their sales careers and advance within the organization.


**Your key responsibilities:**
------------------------------


* Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through outbound prospecting, including calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.
* Leverage sales tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator and CRM software to research and engage with potential customers.
* Customize outreach strategies by researching prospects' goals, market trends, and pain points.
* Educate prospects on how Vonage API solutions can address their business challenges.
* Maintain detailed records of customer interactions and insights in our CRM system.
* Collaborate with marketing, account managers, and sales leadership to refine messaging and improve sales strategies.
* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly targets for qualified meetings and new opportunities.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------


* A proactive and determined mindset with a passion for delivering solutions to customers.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage high volumes of outreach efficiently.
* Excellent communication skills \- both written and verbal \- with a strong ability to listen and engage.
* A highly collaborative approach with a focus on teamwork and shared success.
* Creativity in prospecting strategies and the ability to take initiative.
* Proven ability to meet and exceed ambitious targets.
* Previous experience in Sales Development, particularly in a fast\-paced SaaS environment, is preferred. However, we welcome candidates eager to develop their sales careers.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other sales tools is an advantage.

**Where you will work:**
------------------------


* Hybrid work in Atlanta, GA
* Legal authorization to work in the USA is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
* This is a salaried role and would be part of our Commission Compensation structure. The overall compensation would be based on a 70/30 split.
* Disclaimer: The posted range represents the good faith salary for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined by factors including (but not limited to) geographic location, relevant experience, specific skill sets, and internal equity.


\#LI\-ML1

**There's no perfect candidate.** You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.



To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our **Privacy Notice**.


**Who we are:**



Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands \- such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat \- accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable\-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.



Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

jobs.title: Youth Program Coordinator (High School - Academics)
jobs.description:
**Project: VISION is a nonprofit organization with a mission to help youth of Chicago’s Greater Chinatown community achieve their full potential by providing them with tools for educational, personal, and civic development. PV serves over 500 middle and high school youth each year out of its two Chinatown youth centers as well as three local school\-based sites. We are seeking a mission\-driven, creative, and energetic individual to join our team and serve as a Youth Program Coordinator within our High School Scholars Program.**

**The ideal candidate is committed to our mission and has experience and passion for working with young people. They are also driven by a growth mindset and thrive in a fast\-paced, impact\-based work environment.** 

The Youth Program Coordinator’s role will focus on supporting youths’ academic achievement via after school tutoring and enrichment programs. These programs aim to help youth build foundational knowledge and effective study skills and habits, which promote high school graduation and college access and success. The Coordinator will also work collaboratively with other team members to support other program components such as service learning and leadership programs.

The primary responsibilities of the Youth Program Coordinator will include the following:

* Oversee the daily after school tutoring program
* Facilitate day to day tutoring activities, ensuring that all students are engaged with their homework and getting the support that they need from their assigned tutors
* Supervise and facilitate the workflow of Lead Tutors and Tutors
* Develop and implement weekly academic enrichment activities, which strengthen student knowledge and skills in core high school subjects
* Coach and mentor a cohort of 20\-30 youth who experience academic challenges, including English Language Learners, by holding regular one\-on\-one goal\-setting and check\-in meetings with each youth
* Ensure accurate and thorough documentation of students’ academic activities and progress
* Understand the process and performance metrics that need to be captured for program evaluation and support program evaluation by collecting data and utilizing evaluation tools:
* Track weekly student attendance and follow up with students to encourage consistent attendance and participation
* Collect and evaluate students’ quarterly grades, and coordinate additional academic support or interventions for students as needed
* Report program data and metrics via PV or funder designated tracking and reporting tools
* Train and evaluate Lead Tutors, Tutors, and volunteers, setting up and leading 1:1 meetings for feedback loops and continuous support/improvement, including, but not limited to hosting development sessions on best practices for tutoring and mentoring
* Recruit and enroll youth into the program
* Conduct outreach and build partnerships and collaborations with other local organizations and schools when needed as well as host community building events for youth
* Communicate with youth about program expectations and standards and create improvement plans with youth as needed

Other responsibilities include:

* Support other program activities when needed, including coordinating service learning activities and leadership workshops in collaboration with other Program Coordinators
* Provide administrative support to service and leadership programs, including student recruitment, data collection, and other grant compliance and administrative tasks
* Work with the Parent Engagement Coordinator to engage parents with regular communications and other supports
* Work with the Case Manager to identify youth who may need additional external services (e.g. supporting mental health, basic needs, etc.) and help coordinate access to resources as needed
* Help identify program improvement needs and implement program improvement plans
* Attend and actively participate in team meetings
* Attend trainings regularly to stay abreast of best practices in youth programming as well as to meet funder requirements
* Create and implement a 6\- week summer program, lesson planning, record keeping, and field trip planning for approximately 40\-45 youth participants, ages 14\-15 years old.

**Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's degree required
* Minimum of 1 year of experience working with high school youth required
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google applications
* Minimum of conversational spoken Chinese Cantonese and/or Mandarin highly preferred
* Other qualifications for consideration will be:
* Demonstrated strong interest in a nonprofit career in youth development
* Values alignment with the organization, including commitment to its mission and goals and the issues of AAPI and immigrant youth and families and the local Chinatown community
* Ability to problem solve, offering ideas and suggestions while working with team members to overcome challenges
* Self\-driven work ethic and resilience as demonstrated by exhibiting ownership of projects, taking initiative, and able to adapt to shifting priorities and needs of the organization
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and capacity to manage multiple projects and occasional high volume of work with efficiency and without sacrificing quality
* Positive attitude with ability to problem solve in the face of challenges and turn negative outcomes into learning opportunities as well as using feedback to implement changes as needed
* Comfortability with working independently but also able to work in a team environment and willing to ask for help when needed
* Strong verbal and written communication skills along with strong interpersonal skills
* Understanding of restorative justice and implementation within a program as well as conflict resolution skills
* Experience managing others, including providing training, supervision, and feedback to team members

The pay range for each role reflects Rush’s anticipated wage or salary reasonably expected to be offered for the position. Offers may vary depending on the circumstances of each case.


Job Summary:
  

The Clinical Research Coordinator I (CRC I) supports the conduct of clinical research studies across a range of disciplines. Receives direction from principal investigator, supervisor, or other staff involved in research protocol(s). Responsibilities include participant recruitment and interaction, study data collection and entry, maintenance of study and regulatory documentation, sponsor communication, and adherence to study protocols and policies. The CRC I executes defined study tasks with guidance, ensuring operational compliance, accurate data entry, and participant safety. Exemplifies the Rush mission, vision and values and acts in accordance with Rush policies and procedures.


Required Job Qualifications:
  

Education:
  

* Bachelor’s degree

Experience:
  

* 0\-2 years of experience in a research study or other relevant experience

OR
  

Experience (in lieu of a degree)
  

* Two (2\) years’ total experience, where 1 year is supporting or coordinating research studies

  

Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:
  

* Time Management – Ability to meet deadlines and manage assigned study tasks.
* Problem\-Solving – Ability to troubleshoot routine field issues and use discretion to escalate appropriately when unplanned events arise.
* Attention to Detail – Strong attention to accuracy in data collection and documentation.
* Participant Relations – Ability to build rapport, navigate sensitive topics, and maintain participant confidentiality.
* Communication Skills – Effective verbal and written communication skills with participants and internal study teams.
* Team Collaboration – Ability to collaborate within multi\-disciplinary team settings and follow established workflows.
* Flexibility – Availability to work evenings, overnight shifts, or weekends if required by study protocols.
* Travel Readiness – Availability for local travel as necessary.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

Preferred Job Qualifications:
  

Experience:
  

* Two (2\) or more years prior experience in clinical research or related field
Job Responsibilities:
  

1\. Recruits, consents, screens, schedules, tracks and provides study updates to study participants throughout the conduct of the study.
  

2\. Collects and enters data into study case report forms and/or electronic data capture system and responds to queries in a timely manner.
  

3\. Assists in preparing simple data summaries, reports, or charts to support study documentation and reporting requirements.
  

4\. Maintains accurate and complete procedural documentation including study participant and site level documentation in compliance with institutional, local, state and federal guidelines and regulations related to clinical research.
  

5\. Verifies data against 100% of source documentation for accuracy before entry into case report forms and electronic data capture systems to ensure timeliness and audit readiness.
  

6\. May collect, process and ship potentially biohazardous specimens.
  

7\. Administers structured tests and questionnaires according to research study protocols. May utilize study\-related technology and equipment as part of assessment procedures.
  

8\. Provide ongoing study status updates and responds to questions from PI, Administrator, department stakeholders, Sponsor and Compliance throughout the conduct of the study.
  

9\. Maintains study flow by communicating promptly with study participants and coordinating with study team members as directed.
  

10\. Participate in auditing and monitoring visits. Gather and communicate unanticipated problems (protocol deviations, adverse events, and serious adverse events).
  

11\. Work with PI(s), sponsor, compliance, clinical staff and/or manager to identify and improve routine processes as it relates to the conduct of the research study.
  

12\. Other duties as assigned.

Every hour of therapy counts — for a child learning to eat independently, say their sibling's name, or build the confidence they've never had before. You make those moments possible by keeping schedules full, communication clear, and families supported.



Across our centers, our therapists, Clinical Directors, and families will tell you the same thing: "I don't know what we'd do without our FCA."

* A multitasker who can juggle 10 moving pieces without losing the warmth in their voice.
* A communicator who knows how to spin chaos into clarity.
* A schedules\-and\-systems thinker who loves finding the fastest path to a solution.
* A relationship\-builder who wants families to feel seen, supported, and appreciated.


If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!


**What** **You'll** **Do**

**Family Experience \& Operations**

You're not just managing logistics — you're shaping a family's entire experience of therapy. You'll join a supportive team, build real relationships with families, and play a vital part in helping kids access the care they need.



If you're looking for a role where every day is meaningful and every detail matters, we'd love to talk.

jobs.description:
**About SLHeeley Tax**

SLHeeley Tax provides individuals and businesses with reliable, affordable tax preparation, bookkeeping, and payroll services. We are a close\-knit, highly collaborative team consisting of our President (who leads tax preparation and bookkeeping), our Vice President (who steers our HR, office management, and administrative operations), an additional tax accountant, 5 bookkeepers, 2 dedicated assistants, and an office coordinator.

**We are currently hiring for an Executive Assistant to the Vice President who will serve as the right hand to the VP.**

We pride ourselves on maintaining a low\-key, laid\-back environment with a relaxed, family feel. Our team is a group of sarcastic and snarky people who genuinely enjoy working together. If you prefer a workplace with absolute corporate stiffness, we are probably not the right fit. But if you have thick skin, appreciate good wit, and want an office where you can truly be yourself, you will fit right in.

**Why Join Us? (The Perks)**

* **The "No\-Fridays" Off\-Season:** Enjoy incredible work\-life balance! From May through December, our office is completely closed on Fridays.
* **Relaxed Dress Code:** We are strictly business\-casual even during the tax rush (jeans paired with a nice top, sweater, or an official SLHeeley sweatshirt).
* **Supportive, Educational Leadership:** Our Vice President is a patient, approachable former teacher who loves to guide, answer questions, and help you learn. Management will gradually add new things to your plate as you master tasks.
* **Growth\-Driven, Adaptive Roles:** Your compensation and daily focus will scale directly with your capabilities. We start pay on the standard end, but as you master tasks and take more off leadership's plate **during your initial 4 months with us, your hourly pay will increase.** These positions are built to adapt over time; as we see which high\-level aspects of the VP’s workload you can confidently take over, we will reshape the roles to lean into your personal strengths and maximize firm efficiency.
* **Annual July 1st Pay Reviews:** Following your initial onboarding period, we provide a yearly pay increase based on overall performance, evaluated every year on **July 1st**.
* **Annual Performance Bonus:** Every February, we award a year\-end bonus based on a percentage of your salary that scales upward based on management evaluation and the unique value you brought to the table throughout the year.
* **Robust Health Benefits:** We offer Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) PPO and HMO health insurance plans, and **we cover 50% of the employee\-only premium.**
* **Generous Paid Time Off:** 10 paid days off for scheduled holiday office closures PLUS approximately 66 hours of individual PTO in your first year.

**Work Schedule \& Seasonal Realities**

Our workflow operates like a pendulum, and you must be comfortable managing both extremes:

* *Extended hours:* The office stays open late on **Mondays and Tuesdays until 8:00 PM**, and is open for **six Saturdays total (4 hours each)**. These shifts are **split across our entire 3\-person administrative team**, keeping your individual schedule fair. Exact schedule is finalized together as an Admin Team in December to give you time to plan for evening and Saturday hours.
* *Note on Leadership Presence:* The VP and President are remote a few days every week, making your role as an on\-site anchor and gatekeeper incredibly important.
* **Off\-Season (Mid\-April – December):** The office shifts to a quiet, slow, and relaxed pace. You will work 35–40 hours per week across a highly flexible Monday through Thursday schedule (Closed Fridays).

**Core Responsibilities**

**Process Improvement \& Workflow Optimization**

* Manage and track the internal flow of tax returns ensuring documents move efficiently from intake through final delivery.
* Manage secure electronic delivery of client tax returns to clients.
* Assist with tax return assembly, including organizing and cleaning up client documents electronically and manually.
* Compile tax return folders, handle year\-end mailings (including organizers), and respond to general inquiries regarding past, current, or pending returns.
* Bring an active eye for optimization; analyze current office flows, brainstorm creative ways to improve existing administrative systems, and help streamline office operations.

**Executive Support \& Client Relations**

* Serve as the primary communication liaison and professional gatekeeper for the VP, communicating with clients on their behalf regarding tax, administrative, or bookkeeping updates.
* Screen incoming correspondence, manage executive calendars, and accurately assess leadership availability.
* Draft memos on business topics and assist with special projects for senior leadership.
* Handle customer complaints with patience, provide appropriate solutions within time limits, and follow up to ensure total client satisfaction.
* Communicate with vendors on behalf of Executive Team.

**Office Operations \& Administration**

* Manage incoming/outgoing client documents via the company portal, send out DocuSign requests, and assist with engagement letters.

* Serve as backup support for the Front Desk when necessary.
* Assist with Human Resources (HR) duties.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of office administration or professional assistant experience required. Experience working within a CPA, accounting, or tax firm is highly preferred.
* **Software Savvy:** Highly computer literate and proficient with Microsoft Office products. Familiarity w

jobs.title: Catering Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Catering Operations Manager**

Hours: Tuesday\-Saturday


Customary Days: Sunday through Saturday


Customary Hours: Varies to include evenings, holidays, and extended hours as needed.


Location: Chicago,IL

**About One Off Hospitality:**


For almost 30 years, One Off Hospitality has developed and operated some of Chicago’s most beloved places to eat and drink. More importantly, we’re a group of people – chefs, hospitality veterans, managers and creators – who believe in the power of treating our guests like family and our restaurants like home.

**Job Summary**


The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the successful execution of off\-premise catering events from planning through completion. This position manages event logistics, staffing, food and equipment transportation, setup and breakdown, client service, and operational standards. The ideal candidate is highly organized, solutions\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple events, teams, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**Responsibilities**:


* Oversee daily catering operations and ensure events are executed efficiently, professionally, and according to company standards.
* Coordinate all operational details for off\-premise events, including staffing, transportation, equipment, food, rentals, setup, service, and breakdown.
* Review event orders and production sheets to ensure all event requirements are understood and properly communicated.
* Develop staffing plans and schedules based on event size, service style, location, and operational needs.
* Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate catering staff, servers, bartenders, captains, porters, and event support personnel.
* Lead event teams onsite and serve as the primary operations contact for staff, vendors, venues, and clients when required.
* Collaborate with the warehouse manager to ensure food, beverage, equipment, décor, and supplies are accurately loaded, transported, delivered, and returned.
* Collaborate with the warehouse manager to establish and maintain efficient systems for loading vehicles, inventory control, equipment organization, and event breakdown.
* Monitor labor costs, overtime, product usage, and operational expenses while maintaining service quality.
* Coordinate with culinary, sales, event planning, and administrative teams to ensure seamless communication and execution.
* Troubleshoot event\-day issues and make quick, professional decisions when unexpected challenges arise.
* Maintain high standards for food safety, sanitation, personal appearance, customer service, and workplace safety.
* Conduct post\-event reviews and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, profitability, and guest experience.
* Manage relationships with venues, rental companies, staffing agencies, transportation providers, and other operational partners.
* Coordinate with the warehouse to ensure all company vehicles, catering equipment, tools, and supplies are properly maintained and accounted for.
* Assist with forecasting operational needs and developing procedures that support company growth.
* Attend menu meetings, sales meetings, and production meetings as scheduled
* Attend networking events
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications**

**Skills and Traits for Success:**

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and reliable follow through
* A customer\-centered approach to hospitality
* Knowledge of current industry trends
* Strong creative, presentation, and problem\-solving skills
* Creative skills to provide innovative solutions and strong presentation skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with staff, vendors, and cross\-functional teams
* Experience working with Microsoft Office, Tripleseat, Canva,7shifts, Gmail, Google Docs or similar programs a plus

**Required Education/Experience:**

**Qualifications**

* 3–5\+ years of experience in catering, hospitality, events, restaurant operations, or a related field.
* Previous management or supervisory experience.
* Experience with off\-premise catering and event execution strongly preferred.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple events and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to remain calm and make decisions under pressure.
* Strong understanding of staffing, event logistics, and customer service.
* Comfortable working evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on event schedules.
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record, if driving company vehicles is required.
* Food safety certification such as ServSafe is preferred.
* Ability to lift and move catering equipment and supplies, typically up to 50 lbs.


Key Performance Indicators
Success in this role will be measured by:

* Successful, on\-time execution of events
* Client satisfaction and retention
* Labor cost management
* Accurate event staffing
* Minimal equipment/product loss
* Operational efficiency
* Staff performance and retention
* Food safety and compliance
* Effective communication between departments
* Profitability of catered events


Physical Requirements

* Regularly required to communicate with clients, team members, and vendors in person and by phone
* Frequently required to stand, walk, and use hands for office and event\-related activities

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Accelerate your career at RXO**  

RXO is a leading provider of transportation solutions. With cutting\-edge technology at the center, we're revolutionizing the industry with our massive network and commitment to finding solutions for every challenge. We create more efficient ways for shippers and carriers to transport goods across North America.


Compensation for this role is $50,000\-55,000 The role may also be eligible for bonus or commission pay. Actual compensation may vary due to factors such as experience and skill set.
As a Key Account Manager at RXO, you’ll serve as the daily point of contact and relationship manager for our most important clients.


What your day\-to\-day will look like:


* Serve as an advocate and liaison for RXO’s top clients to ensure overall customer satisfaction
* Expand current customer accounts through ongoing relationship development
* Collaborate with team members to secure the terms of sale, including negotiating rates, identifying carriers, procuring specialized equipment, etc.

* Ensure the integrity of the shipment and the RXO brand by following standard processes and procedures
* Update internal tracking and reporting systems throughout the day to maintain accuracy in sales and volume metrics
* Monitor and ensure accurate billing; strive to ensure mutually beneficial business operations

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work or military experience
* 1 year of professional experience

It’d be great if you also have:


* 5 years of experience in a transportation sales environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Does this sound like you? Check out what else RXO has to offer.**

**Why Join Us:**

**Our Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Paid time off includes: up to 8 holidays, up to 2 floating Diversity Days, Hourly: Earn up to 13 days PTO/ Salary: Earn up to 15 days PTO, up to 40 hours bereavement leave, up to 16 hours volunteer time, jury duty, at least 2 weeks family bonding leave, up to 40 hours prenatal care leave

* Insurance: health, prescription, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life, short and long\-term disability, accidental death and personal loss, business travel, legal services, ID theft, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance
* Tax\-Advantaged Accounts: Health Savings Account, Health Care Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Commuter Spending Account

Our values are the key to our unique culture and our ability to deliver for everyone we serve.


We do great things when we are inclusive and work together. To perform with excellence, we learn from one another, value diverse perspectives, operate safely and build strong relationships.


**The Next Step**  

Ready to join our team? We'd love to hear from you. Fill out an application now and join our talent community to learn about future opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. jobs.description:
**Job description**

**Location: Los Angeles, California**

**Position Summary**


Lead and direct V\&V’s account development/management and selling efforts to assertively increase revenue and tonnage sales through national and regional Food Service chains.

**Five Primary Responsibilities**

* Develop and aggressively implement formalized plans to gain and expand sales to major/national supermarket chains and position V\&V Supremo Foods as a “value creating” supplier and business partner.
* Responsible for calling key customers, directs and coordinates the involvement of V\&V Supremo foods sales resources, brokers and distributors in selling to and supporting these customers.
* Hands on customer development and business manage with customers and other key decision makers/influencers within headquarter locations.
* Partner with Sales Managers and their sales teams to develop and manage relationships with buyers and other key decision makers/influencers at these customers’ buying/operating centers.
* Responsible for managing customer total profit and loss results. Develop, monitor and support the implementation of agreed to marketing and sales promotion plans with these customer.

**Key Activities**

* Work with the National Sales Director to identify and prioritize national Food Service chains and regional chains in target markets for growth that V\&V Supremo Foods will aggressively pursue
* For each high\-priority Food Service chain, develop and monitor/manage the implementation of an overall account plan that defines the following: specific V\&V Supremo Foods sales objectives, approved sales and marketing programs, if/where/how third\-party brokers and distributors will be used in selling to and supporting the customer, key contacts in the customer’s organization and who is responsible for developing relationships with these people, and clarifies the accountabilities and expectations of both parties for increasing V\&V Supremo Foods sales
* Proactively build senior level relationships, introduce new products, identify and gain agreement for immediate sales opportunities and marketing programs, review historical sales results and the value they have created for Food Service chains, and develop longer\-term account strategies by calling on these customers’ headquarters location.
* Establish and communicate priorities to brokers and distributors in implementing longer\-term account plans and short\-term sales plans for these national accounts.
* Partner with the Sales teams, brokers and distributors to develop and manage relationships and achieve sales goals with key individuals at these customers’ regional offices and to ensure that agreed to sales and marketing programs are effectively implemented in the field.
* Work with customer buyers and Sales Managers to develop accurate sales budgets and forecasts for designated customers.
* Responsible for resolving problems that negatively impact sales with designated customers
* Share important customer and competitor information with the Sales team.
* Provide timely and accurate reports, budgets, forecasts and other data as required.
* Responsible for ensuring that accounts receivables are not delinquent.
* Responsible for complying to all Safe Quality Food (SQF) polices/procedures and requirements for position.
* Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.

**Performance Metrics**

* Food Service national accounts revenue and tonnage attainment vs. goals
* Food Service national accounts overall profitability vs. goals.
* New product introductions.
* Customer satisfaction.
* The quality and successful implementation of customer\-specific account plans.
* A/R responsibility.
* Data reporting accuracy.

Regionally assigned customers

* Distributors assigned to these accounts

* National Sales Director(s)
* Sales Managers/teams
* Marketing Dept.
* Customer Relationship Associates
* Finance Dept.
* Other functional managers
* V\&V Supremo Foods senior management
* Other National Accounts Managers

**Skills Required**

* Knowledgeable of sales through customer warehouses, distributors, brokers and DSD.
* Able to take ownership for the Food Service business nationwide from a strategic perspective, and to drive sales with national accounts.
* Effective leader/communicator
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build very good working relationships at the national account and major regional account level.
* Hands\-on and can\-do attitude
* Analytic skills, data interpretation, ability to prepare and deliver effective presentations.

**Necessary Experience**

**Requirements:**

* Outside B2B sales and proven successful track record, including national. Grocery account management experience
* 5 plus years continuous experience in Food Industry sales.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in perishables, ideally dairy.
* Experience successfully targeting the Latino and General market.
* A plus if fully fluent in English and Spanish (written and spoken)

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Big Happy is looking for an Account Manager to build and grow relationships with some of our most important brand and agency partners. Reporting to a Senior Account Manager, this role sits at the center of our client experience and ensures campaigns launch smoothly, perform strongly, and ultimately turn into long\-term partnerships.  

As the primary post\-sale lead for your accounts, you will guide campaigns from kickoff through reporting while partnering closely with internal teams to drive revenue and repeat business. You will combine strong client instincts, attention to detail, and a solutions\-first mindset to help clients get the most from Big Happy's platform. A white\-glove approach to service, paired with close coordination across teams, is central to succeeding in this role.
  

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-moving environment, enjoys building meaningful relationships, and takes pride in delivering thoughtful work that drives client success.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as the main point of contact for brand and agency clients across all post\-sale activities, including:
	+ Leading campaign kick\-off calls with media and creative agencies to ensure creative production aligns with campaign objectives, brainstorming custom creative (Sunrises, AR, 3D, Games, etc.), reviewing production timelines, and serving as a subject matter expert on all things Big Happy
	+ Gathering campaign launch materials — assets, brand guidelines, campaign messaging, third\-party tracking, site lists, block lists, etc. — and confirming accuracy for timely launch
	+ Leading creative production with the creative team and serving as liaison between the client and internal teams to bring a client's creative vision to life while aligning with Big Happy best practices
	+ Monitoring campaign performance and providing clients with weekly reporting, with an eye toward optimizing and showing improvement week over week against client KPIs
	+ Ensuring all campaign elements are accurately tracking and flagging discrepancies with PAS, Ops, and Tech teams
	+ Building and presenting end\-of\-campaign reports with a focus on actionable learnings and recommendations that drive client renewals or incremental growth
* Partner closely with Sales, Strategy, Creative, Tech, and Ops to keep client deliverables, campaign launches, and execution on track

### **Skills, Knowledge and Experience**

  

* 2\-4 years of experience in digital advertising, ideally within an agency, publisher, or ad tech environment
* Strong understanding of the digital media ecosystem and how brands, agencies, and publishers collaborate
* Experience managing campaigns across the full lifecycle, from kickoff to reporting
* Comfort working with third\-party measurement and verification partners such as IAS, DoubleVerify, DCM, Lucid, or Nielsen, — and ability to lead troubleshooting with third\-party vendors
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and the broader Microsoft Office suite, with the ability to translate campaign data into clear insights and compelling client narratives
* Familiarity with programmatic and managed service media environments; experience with platforms like DV360, Xandr, or The Trade Desk is a plus

jobs.title: Customer Account Manager - Schaumburg, IL
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**What is a Customer Account Manager (CAM)?**


At Advance Auto Parts, a Customer Account Manager (CAM) sells or oversees the selling of automotive products for repair or distribution to automotive repair shops and other commercial businesses. The CAM must be committed to inspiring our team, helping our customers succeed, and growing the business and profitability with integrity.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Work with District Leaders, General Managers and other key personnel to achieve all agreed upon goals for assigned accounts
* Implement new Commercial Sales programs, as well as support current programs
* Visit assigned accounts, making sales calls and developing approaches that best position products, services, or ideas; identify and meet the needs of commercial customers. Maintain database of account sales call activity, etc.
* Proactively communicate with Store Team on a regular basis to ensure that customer expectations concerning product availability, accuracy, and delivery timelines are realistic and being met
* Provide feedback and input to business partners regarding competitive information, merchandising suggestions, and other services to strengthen the market position of the company
* Partner in the development and retention of Commercial Parts Pros to support the Advance plan for internal growth and career opportunities
* Demonstrate an eagerness to be a team player and assist in other functions as assigned by Region and Area leaders and as needed, including, but not limited to: cleaning, organizing, stocking, operating POS equipment, truck loading/unloading, etc.

**Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a CAM**

* Working knowledge of Advance products and services and the ability to market those products and services to meet customer need
* Working knowledge of the APAL system, including Inventory Management and processing of Commercial account paperwork
* Working knowledge of automotive systems and traditional automotive aftermarket
* Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and upper management
* Strong presentation and verbal and written communications skills, including ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedural manuals
* Use Microsoft software effectively (Word, Excel required – PowerPoint preferred)
* Calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, percentages, sales increases, and gross profit percent
* Ability to review and analyze business reports, such as profit and loss statement (P\&L)
* Think strategically, analyze issues and options, and effectively manage and facilitate change
* Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed
* Ability to travel overnight occasionally

**Prior Experiences that Set a CAM up for Success**

* Proven sales track record with 3\-5 years related selling experience.

**Education**

* High School diploma or general education degree (GED)
* Associate’s degree or equivalent from a two\-year college or technical school preferred

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**

* Must have a valid driver's license and be fleet safety certified.
* ASE certification preferred, but not required

**Physical Demands**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100


pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**Work Environment**


The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; extreme cold; extreme heat; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

*Position is eligible for sales commission based on individual or store performance.*


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.
**Compensation Range**


The good faith estimate for this role is between 51,500\.00 USD and 63,100\.00 USD salary for a new team member.
The rate offered depends on a number of factors, including geographic location, experience in retail, automotive knowledge, education, leadership roles, and other skillsets ideal for this position and shift differential (if applicable).

**Benefits:** Advance Auto Parts offers a comprehensive health and wellness benefits program to improve the way of life for our Team Members and those who mean the most to them: their families. Find out more by visiting:


Advance Auto Parts\-Home

**California** **Residents click below for Privacy Notice:**


https://jobs.advanceautoparts.com/us/en/disclosures
