jobs.title: LTL Business Development Associate - Ryan Transportation
jobs.description:
About Shamrock Trading Corporation
  
Ryan Transportation is part of Shamrock Trading Corporation, a family of brands that has been serving the transportation and logistics industries since 1986\. Shamrock offers factoring solutions, export financing, third\-party logistics, a fuel card program and trucking technology.
  
Shamrock’s mission since the start has been to create value and success for our customers, our partners and our people. Strong ethics, dedication to our customers and close attention to the marketplace are critical to the success and growth of the Shamrock brands. Shamrock is headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas, with multiple offices throughout the U.S. Our Chicago office is located in the heart of Lombard offering a convenient commute and quick access to several shopping, dining and recreational options. With panoramic views of the area and a winning culture, Shamrock is a great place to work in Chicago!
  
Why You’ll Love Working Here
  
Our award\-winning culture is a testament to our commitment to growth, recognition and empowerment. From day one, we prioritize employees first, encouraging them to think and act like owners and providing endless opportunities for growth and self\-development, both personally and professionally. Shamrock has been recognized as one of America’s 2025 “Most Loved Workplaces” by Newsweek.
  
At Shamrock, we hire bright, ambitious people and give them the tools they need for a successful, long\-term career here. Shamrock also offers a premier set of benefits for employees and their families:
  
* Unlimited Earnings: Uncapped commission, competitive base salary and ongoing opportunities to advance your professional career
* Training and Development: Industry\-leading training programs, including a Freight Immersion Training (FIT) Program for sales employees entering the transportation industry and a LEAD Program for aspiring leaders
* Medical: Fully paid healthcare, dental and vision premiums for employees and eligible dependents, and gym benefits
* Financial: Generous company 401(k) contributions, employee stock ownership after one year and free resources to build long\-term financial security
* Recognition and Awards: Sales incentives, quarterly employee awards and opportunities to celebrate individual and team success
* Work\-Life Balance: Competitive PTO, fully paid time off for holidays and opportunities to volunteer within your community


About the Role
  
Ryan Transportation, a Shamrock company, is seeking an accomplished and highly competitive sales professional to join our team as an LTL Business Development Associate. This role is designed for a driven hunter who thrives on winning new business and building long\-term client partnerships in the freight brokerage and third\-party logistics space, with a focus on LTL accounts.
  
In this position, you will be responsible for identifying, pursuing, and securing new LTL shipper accounts while strategically expanding relationships with existing customers. You will leverage deep industry knowledge, a consultative approach, and a relentless drive to deliver transportation solutions that create value and strengthen client relationships. Success in this position requires exceptional sales acumen, a proven track record of closing high\-value deals, and the ability to excel in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment. This is an in\-office, performance\-based role with significant earning potential for individuals who consistently meet and exceed business objectives.
  
What You’ll Do
  
* Consistently prospect and secure new LTL shippers, with a heavy emphasis on accounts in the small and mid\-sized business segments.
* Close and convert high\-potential prospects into long\-term clients
* Build, grow, and maintain strategic relationships with existing customers to maximize account value.
* Work with BDMs in the FTL and TM groups to identify other transportation mode opportunities.
* Identify and pursue opportunities to expand business within current accounts
* Manage and advance a robust sales pipeline through effective use of CRM for lead handling, call tracking, and opportunity management
* Serve as an industry expert in LTL shipping and LTL pricing and advise clients with insight and credibility
* Collaborate with leadership to refine sales strategies and drive business growth
* Oversee customer onboarding, including contract negotiation, account setup, and operational handoff


What You’ll Bring
  
* 1\-2 years of proven success in high\-performance B2B sales, preferably in LTL and freight brokerage, logistics, or a related industry
* Demonstrated ability to develop and close new business through cold calling, networking, and strategic outreach
* Track record of exceeding sales targets in a competitive, quota\-driven environment
* Proficiency with CRM tools and disciplined pipeline management
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to mentor and influence others
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication abilities
* Self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and able to thrive with minimal supervision
* Experience in transportation, manufacturing, distribution, or food industries a plus
* Willingness to travel as needed


Apply Today!
  
We’re so excited to connect with you! If you want to work with forward\-thinking people in an award\-winning culture, submit your application today.
  
Having trouble submitting your application? Contact us at Recruiting@shamrocktradingcorp.com for support.

jobs.title: Product Manager- Client Onboarding
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.  

As a Product Manager in Client Onboarding and Servicing, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.  

**Job responsibilities**

* Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
* Builds the framework and tracks the product's key success metrics such as cost, feature and functionality, risk posture, and reliability
* Direct the principal activities across the end‑to‑end product delivery journey—intake, dependency management, release and deployment, and product operationalization—with a focus on feasibility and readiness.
* Leads the completion of change management activities across functional partners and ensures adherence to the firm's risk, controls, compliance, and regulatory requirements
* Effectively manages timelines and dependencies while monitoring blockers, ensuring adequate resourcing, and liaising with stakeholders and functional partners
* Maintain a transparent portfolio view of timelines, cross‑team dependencies, and environmental constraints; identify and resolve blockers early.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics
* Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management
* Demonstrated ability to execute operational management and change readiness activities
* Proven ability engaging with a technology and business audience alike
* Proficiency in data and analytics to inform prioritization, measure performance, and drive decisions.
* Deep experience with risk, controls, compliance, and regulatory requirements embedded in delivery.
* Strong structured problem\-solving skills (hypothesis\-driven analysis, root\-cause identification, prioritization) and the ability to translate complexity into clear executive narratives and decision\-ready materials.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management; ability to lead through influence and drive cross‑functional outcomes.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Excel Restoration is a fast\-growing restoration company specializing in water, fire, and mold mitigation, along with full\-service reconstruction. We pride ourselves on professionalism, accountability, and delivering exceptional service to our customers and partners.

As we continue to grow across our Elk Grove Village, IL and West Allis, WI locations, we’re looking for a creative, energetic Social Media \& Content Creator to help us build our brand and tell the Excel Restoration story online.

**The Opportunity**  
We’re looking for someone who can take the work we do every day and turn it into engaging content that people actually want to watch.

From documenting restoration projects and before\-and\-after transformations to highlighting our team, sharing educational content, and showcasing the day\-to\-day life of a restoration company, you’ll help bring the Excel Restoration brand to life across social media.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being behind the camera just as much as they enjoy being behind a computer. You should be comfortable coming up with content ideas, filming on location, editing videos, writing captions, and staying on top of social media trends.

You’ll work closely with our team and leadership to develop a consistent content strategy and create content that increases brand awareness, builds trust with customers and partners, and helps position Excel Restoration as a leader in the restoration industry.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute a consistent social media content strategy across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube
* Film high\-quality video and photo content at our offices, job sites, and restoration projects
* Capture before\-and\-after transformations, project walkthroughs, team spotlights, educational content, customer\-focused stories, and behind\-the\-scenes footage
* Edit short\-form videos and other social media content for online publishing
* Create engaging Reels, TikToks, Stories, Shorts, and other platform\-specific content
* Write captions, develop hooks, and help create content that encourages engagement
* Identify trending formats, sounds, topics, and content opportunities that can be adapted to the restoration industry
* Build and maintain a consistent social media posting schedule
* Collaborate with leadership and team members to develop new content ideas
* Help showcase the expertise, professionalism, culture, and personality of Excel Restoration
* Monitor social media performance and use analytics to identify what content is performing well
* Help grow our audience, engagement, and overall online presence
* Maintain an organized library of photos and video footage
* Travel between our Elk Grove Village, IL and West Allis, WI locations and job sites as needed

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience creating content for social media, either professionally or through personal projects
* Strong knowledge of platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube
* Experience filming and editing video
* Familiarity with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar
* A strong understanding of what makes short\-form content engaging
* Creative instincts and the ability to come up with new content ideas
* Strong communication and storytelling skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* Comfortable being around active job sites and working in a hands\-on environment
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple pieces of content at different stages
* Willingness to get out from behind the desk and capture content in the field
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with photography or videography
* Experience operating DSLR or mirrorless cameras
* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud
* Experience creating TikToks, Reels, or YouTube Shorts
* Experience managing a business or brand's social media accounts
* Experience with paid social media advertising
* Experience with graphic design
* Experience in construction, restoration, home services, real estate, or another field\-based industry
* A portfolio or examples of content you've created

**What Success Looks Like**  
In this role, success means making Excel Restoration more visible, recognizable, and engaging online.

* You'll help us consistently publish content that showcases our projects, educates our audience, highlights our team, and gives potential customers and partners a reason to trust and remember Excel Restoration.
* We aren't looking for someone who simply checks a box by posting three times a week. We're looking for someone who sees an interesting project, grabs a camera, finds the story, edits the footage, and turns it into something people want to watch.
* If you're creative, self\-motivated, comfortable in a fast\-paced environment, and excited about building something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator (In Store)
jobs.description:
### **Position**

**Overview:**

Tiffany \& Co… the name instills images of Beauty, Romance and the iconic Blue Box. It is a Symbol of Excellence. For 175 years, Tiffany has created a legacy of exquisite designs and romantic ideals. Tiffany \& Co.'s rich heritage of celebrated artists, historic milestones and magnificent jewelry creates the foundation from which our employees build upon each day. Tiffany employees are passionate, kind and professionally committed. We hold ourselves and our co\-workers to very high standards. We continually educate ourselves about new merchandise collections, cultures and the evolving luxury market. Our respect and love for the brand creates a workplace like no other.  



Tiffany employees honor every special moment in our customer's lives and every unique gift that commemorates their milestones. This differentiating factor, known as the Tiffany Experience ( *Creating Connections, Providing Personalized Experiences and Honoring the Tiffany Legacy)* is never compromised…. and it never will be.  



We expect our employees to deliver the Tiffany Experience to each and every customer and Tiffany is committed to creating an organization that recognizes and rewards excellence in service of this promise. For us, it is a dream to be associated with a company that is forever aligned with exquisite craftsmanship, timeless design and a dedicated commitment to corporate sustainability.  



**Responsibilities:**

The Operations Coordinator takes the lead by performing all back of house operations in a Tiffany store. The Coordinator has a passion for providing excellent client service and partners with store leadership on key initiatives which supports the team and drives sales goals. The Coordinator is a key holder who acts as a manager on duty when a manager is unavailable. Duties include coordinating order fulfillment, managing inventory, coordinating client service activities, and may open and close the store.  



**Sales:** Deepen the relationship with our clients to drive lifetime loyalty and spend. Carry out operations and sales support functions to support the store in consistently achieving or exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual store sales plan. Capture customer data during interactions to cultivate new and existing customers. Act as Guest Experience Manager, key holder, and carryout opening and closing procedures in the absence of a manager. Drive business through key product pillars.  



**Service:** Elevate in store experience by consistently delivering memorable moments. Demonstrate passion as a Tiffany brand ambassador, providing the Tiffany Touch during every client interaction. Demonstrate Client Experience Behaviors identified within the TEI program (Voice of Client Survey). Execute best practices by optimizing hospitality and store amenities to create unique experiences and take action on TEI performance and client feedback. Resolve client and employee concerns utilizing judgment and thorough knowledge of policy, procedure and practice.  



**Operational Excellence:** Provide exceptional operational support to drive sales and service. Execute daily tasks such as order fulfillment, shipping, receiving and replenishment, cleaning jewelry, transferring merchandise, taking in jewelry repairs and cleaning merchandise, following company operational policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with all internal control procedures and maintain inventory accuracy. Partner and communicate effectively with Sales Professionals, Management and clients to respond and follow up to requests quickly and accurately. Support Company operations efficiency objectives by ensuring all activities maximize productivity and by providing feedback on process changes through appropriate channels. Assist management in coordinating work and coaching team members to improve performance when acting as manager on duty. Takes the lead, partnering with the operations professional to ensure operational excellence in all tasks.  



**Qualifications:**

Required Qualifications:


* 2\-3 years of prior retail experience in retail operations with comprehensive knowledge of merchandising, client service, administration and shipping.
* Strong Analytical skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Ability to work retail store hours as necessary, including nights, weekends and holidays.
* Organized and detail oriented.
* Flexibility to perform different tasks based on day\-to\-day business needs.
* Must have authorization to work in the United States or in the country where the position is based.

Preferred Qualifications:


* A college/university degree.
Graduate Gemologist degree or previous Gemological Institute of America (GIA) course work.  
* 

Illinois Wage Transparency Disclosure\-$24\.65\-$29\.00


***TIFFANY \& CO.***
**MAISON**
-------------------------------

Founded in 1837 by Charles Lewis Tiffany in New York City, Tiffany \& Co. is one of the world’s most prestigious houses for jewelry and accessories. Love has been the driving force of Tiffany \& Co. since its inception, uniting the jeweler’s core values of inventiveness, craft and joy in designs that endure across generations.
  

As a global pioneer in the art of fine jewelry, Tiffany has spent almost two centuries perfecting its craft and setting benchmarks within the industry. It is through this unwavering vow to excellence and expertise, to heritage and innovation, to optimism and possibility that Tiffany continues its legacy, creating designs that inspire people to express and celebrate the many facets of love.

**Sales Development Representative (Chicago)**

  

You don't pay us. We pay you.


SV Academy is hiring Sales Development Representatives. This is a full\-time job that includes free sales training, a 90\-day paid Residency at a partner company, and a clear path to a long\-term sales role at one of our 400\+ partner companies.


Cohorts begin every week and are limited to 25 Residents. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.

* **Days 1–10** — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor\-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT).
* **Days 11–100** — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base \+ 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W\-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* **Day 100 onward** — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $50k \- $85k in total annual compensation (base \+ commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer to the partner.


No tuition. No loans. No deferred\-income agreement.


We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which means our incentive is to make you successful in the role!

**How the 100 Days Work**

**Days 1–10** — Free sales training. Ten days of live, instructor\-led training. Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT), on Zoom. No cost to you. You'll learn the fundamentals of B2B sales: outbound calls, email and LinkedIn outreach, objection handling, qualification, CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce or HubSpot, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

**Days 11–100** — Paid Residency at a partner company. You'll work full\-time at one of our partner companies as a W\-2 employee of SV Academy. Real sales work: outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn; qualifying inbound leads; scheduling discovery meetings for Account Executives. You'll get daily coaching from an SV Academy mentor and from the partner's sales leadership.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

**About SV Academy**


Since 2017, we've placed more than 6,000 people into full\-time tech sales careers and worked with 400\+ employer partners across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high\-growth verticals.


Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15\+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt\-free pathways into tech careers.


Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.

**Who Tends to Succeed Here**


No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals

If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

Apply today. The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first\-reviewed basis.

The Janitorial Account Manager oversees the delivery, quality, and performance of all custodial and cleaning services across client facilities. * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

new_jobs.description:
**Join SmartFinancial: Empowering Insurers with Cutting\-Edge Technology**


Welcome to SmartFinancial, where our mission is clear: to drive growth and success for insurance agencies through our industry\-leading technology! Voted one of the Best Places to Work for four consecutive years, we are one of the fastest\-growing tech companies.


We are a leading insurance marketplace, connecting millions of shoppers to our network of insurance partners across all 50 states.

**Why This Role Matters**


As a **Customer Success Manager 1** at SmartFinancial, you’ll play a key role in helping insurance agents and agencies succeed on our platform. You’ll manage a growing book of business, build strong client relationships, and work directly with customers to help them maximize the value and performance of their accounts.


This is a entry\-level, in\-office role designed for someone who is motivated by building relationships, solving problems, and achieving measurable results. You’ll work with smaller accounts, re\-engage customers through our win\-back dialer, and identify opportunities to grow accounts to higher monthly spending levels.


CSM1s who consistently meet and exceed performance expectations will be eligible to advance into **Customer Success Manager 2 (CSM2\)** or **Strategic Customer Success Manager (SCSM)** roles.


Our goal is to become the premier Customer Success Team in the Insurtech industry, and you will be an important part of making that happen.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Grow:** Manage a book of **100\+ active accounts**, building strong relationships while identifying opportunities to increase account utilization and monthly spend.
* **Win Back:** Work our win\-back dialer to re\-engage inactive and lower\-spending customers, build your book of business, and create new opportunities for account growth.
* **Optimize:** Review lead performance, filters, pricing, geographic targeting, emails, calls, and other account settings to help clients get the most out of the SmartFinancial platform.
* **Drive Results:** Help customers improve key performance indicators such as cost per acquisition, close rate, lead quality, return on investment, and overall account performance.
* **Retain:** Build trusted customer relationships and proactively identify issues that could impact customer satisfaction, utilization, or retention.
* **Own It:** Serve as a reliable point of contact for your assigned customers, providing consistent communication and helping them achieve their business goals.
* **Solve:** Address customer questions, objections, concerns, and ad\-related complaints using established Customer Success processes and protocols.
* **Excel:** Deliver a best\-in\-class customer experience while consistently achieving the activity, retention, talk\-time, and account\-growth goals associated with the role.

  

**Requirements** **What We’re Looking For**

* **1–2\+ years of experience** in customer service, customer success, sales, account management, or a related client\-facing role preferred.
* Proven ability to meet and exceed **KPIs, activity goals, sales targets, or other performance metrics**.
* Experience working with **insurance agencies, insurance technology, lead generation, or marketplace businesses** is highly valued.
* Experience with **high\-volume calling** and comfort communicating with customers regularly.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and clearly communicate solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to identify opportunities to improve customer performance.
* Highly motivated, **coachable, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment**.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to effectively manage a large book of customer accounts.
* Basic computer proficiency and the ability to quickly learn and utilize new software and technology.
* Must be available for **full\-time, in\-office work**. (6am\-3pm) PST

  

**Benefits** **Why You’ll Love It Here**

* **Base Salary: $70,034**
* **Career Growth:** Start your career as a CSM1 with a clear path toward **CSM2 and Strategic CSM** opportunities for high performers.
* **Training \& Development:** Receive extensive product training, coaching, role\-play opportunities, and ongoing development to help you become an exceptional Customer Success professional.
* **Performance\-Driven:** Your success is measurable. You'll have clear goals and KPIs that allow you to understand exactly what success looks like and how you can continue to grow.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** 401k with company match, along with company\-sponsored health, dental, and life insurance plans.
* **Employee Referral Bonus:** Help us grow our team and earn additional rewards through our employee referral program.
* **World\-Class Culture:** We believe our people and culture are what make SmartFinancial special.


We’d especially like to highlight our **World Class Culture**, which our employees say is the best thing about working at SmartFinancial. We have great SLACK channels for work and play, which keep you connected with your fellow employees throughout the day. Not to mention our top\-notch company events (like our Summer Beach Party with open bar, chili cook\-off, annual holiday yacht party, fun office potlucks and more) that will keep you asking when the next event is.


We also have Penny, our company mascot. Like swag themed after a pink pig wearing glasses? Just. You. Wait.


Join SmartFinancial and become a key player in helping insurance agencies grow their businesses. If you're motivated by relationships, results, and career growth, **apply now and let's achieve success together!**


SmartFinancial is an equal opportunity employer, and we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To learn more about our results\-focused culture and employee\-focused perks, read more on our careers

new_jobs.title: Evening Kitchen Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Evening Kitchen Operations CoordinatorPosition Summary**

The Kitchen Operations Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day production and fulfillment operations of the company’s kitchen, which produces in\-house food products for two retail store locations and specialty catering. This is not a chef or cooking position.

The primary focus of the role is coordinating purchase orders from the retail stores, supporting the kitchen production team, ensuring products are properly labeled and packaged, maintaining quality and accuracy standards, and helping ensure completed products are ready for timely delivery to each store.

The Kitchen Operations Coordinator serves as an important link between the retail stores and kitchen production team, helping ensure that orders are accurately communicated, produced, packaged, labeled, and delivered according to company standards.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Receive, review, and organize purchase orders and product requests from the company’s retail store locations to prepare for delivery.
* Communicate production needs and priorities to the kitchen production team.
* Track orders through the production process and help ensure products are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Coordinate the preparation of completed products for distribution to retail locations.
* Accurately label finished food products in accordance with company procedures and applicable labeling requirements.
* Verify product labels for accuracy, including product identification, dates, quantities, and other required information.
* Perform quality\-control checks on finished products, packaging, labeling, and order quantities before products leave the kitchen.
* Package and prepare products for delivery or retail distribution as needed.
* Compare completed orders against purchase orders to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain organized records related to orders, production, labeling, and fulfillment as required.
* Communicate shortages, production issues, quality concerns, or order discrepancies to appropriate management.
* Help maintain an organized and efficient production and fulfillment workflow.
* Coordinate with retail store employees regarding order status, changes, shortages, or other fulfillment needs.
* Transport products, supplies, or other company materials between the kitchen and retail locations as needed.
* Safely operate a company vehicle or authorized vehicle when driving is required.
* Follow company food\-safety, sanitation, quality\-control, workplace\-safety, and operational procedures.
* Maintain clean and organized packaging, labeling, storage, and work areas.
* Assist with inventory counts, supply organization, receiving, and other kitchen operations activities as needed.
* Provide hands\-on operational support to the kitchen production team as needed, excluding duties requiring a chef or specialized culinary role.
* Receive incoming deliveries.
* Perform other related duties as assigned based on operational needs.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in food production, manufacturing, fulfillment, retail operations, inventory, warehouse operations, or a similar environment preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to accurately quality control purchase orders, labels, quantities, and product information.
* Ability to prioritize multiple orders and communicate effectively with both kitchen and retail teams.
* Dependable and able to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced food\-production environment.
* Basic computer, email, and data\-entry skills.
* Ability to follow established food\-safety, quality\-control, and operational procedures.
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record required as driving is an essential function of the position.
* Bi\-lingual, English/Spanish is required.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical requirements described below are representative of those necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Regularly stand and walk for extended periods.
* Frequently use hands for labeling, packaging, handling products, and performing other operational tasks.
* Regularly reach, bend, stoop, and move throughout kitchen, storage, and production areas.
* Lift, carry, push, and/or move products, boxes, supplies, and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Work in and around a commercial food\-production environment, which may include exposure to hot and cold temperatures, refrigeration areas, food products, cleaning products, and production equipment.
* Safely enter and exit a vehicle and load or unload products when performing delivery duties.

**Work Environment**

This position primarily works within a commercial kitchen/food\-production environment and regularly interacts with kitchen production employees, retail store personnel, and management. The position may also involve periodic driving between company locations and performing duties at retail locations.

**Classification**

**FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt, Full\-Time. 3:30pm\-12:00am \- 5 days/week (Sundays required)**Reports To:** Kitchen Operations Manager

*This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties and responsibilities may be modified based on business and operational needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.*

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 35\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**Job Title: ASLA Coordinator**

**HOW THIS ROLE SUPPORTS THE MISSION**

EOYDC’s After School Leadership Academy (ASLA) provides resources for K\-5 students to develop in the areas of academics, leadership, and character. Under the direction of the ASLA Manager, the ASLA Coordinator is responsible for coordinating all aspects of the ASLA program. These duties include, but are not limited to, supporting the design of ASLA curriculum, implementing lesson plans, training and managing the ASLA Youth Leader interns, assessing program outcomes, and building/maintaining relationships with participants, families, and partner schools.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

This role will collaborate across the organization, sometimes as the lead of a project and sometimes as support. The person in this role will be responsible for ensuring the success of the following:

* Development and facilitation of lessons, activities, field trips, and events that are consistent with the mission of the program for students in grades K\-5
* Creation and adjustment of weekly program schedule in consideration of partner school schedules and organization\-wide events
* ASLA student engagement
* Provide instruction based on engaging lesson plans developed to strengthen academic performance, enhance leadership skills, and develop character
* Supervise children and promote safety and respect amongst all participants
* Identify student academic and behavioral strengths and challenges, and work with the ASLA Manager and team to create appropriate plan to address their unique needs

* Maintain program attendance records and OFCY

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Private Events Sales Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Reports to:**

General Manager (dotted line coordination with Maître'd and Chef)

**Employment type:**

Part\-time — Hourly, non\-exempt, plus commission

**Schedule:**

Standard business hours, with regular evening and weekend availability required for client site tours and to attend events in progress

**Scope:**

Maxwell Alley private events (recommended initial scope — see note at end of document)

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Maxwell Alley is seeking a Private Events Sales Coordinator to own the full sales cycle for our private dining and event space — from first inquiry through signed contract — and to actively grow our events business through outbound outreach. This person is the primary point of contact for prospective event hosts during the decision\-making and booking process, with a hand off to our on\-site events team (Maître'd and General Manager) once a contract is signed. He or she remains financially and administratively responsible for the event through final settlement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Lead Management \& Sales**

* Respond promptly to all incoming private event inquiries — website intake form, email, phone, and other sources — with an acknowledgement the same business day, and a full response/quote within 36 hours.
* Maintain a single, up\-to\-date pipeline of every lead from first contact through signed contract, using Tripleseat software.
* Provide prospective hosts with everything needed to make a decision: availability, pricing, menu options, room capacity, layout possibilities, and decor/rental options.
* Prepare and send proposals, customized menu packages, and floor plans; recommend add\-ons (premium bar packages, florals, AV/entertainment, custom cakes, late\-night extensions) to grow average event value.
* Follow up consistently on open leads through a defined cadence until they convert or are closed out.
* Secure deposits and signed BEOs/contracts, and book confirmed events in Resy.

**Business Development / Outreach**

* Proactively prospect and generate new (“cold”) event business through targeted outreach — cold calling/emailing, list\-building (corporate offices, law firms, nonprofits, wedding and event planners), networking events, and referral relationships with planners and corporate concierges.
* Build and maintain a preferred\-vendor list (florists, bands/DJs, photographers, rental companies) for client referrals.

**Client Management**

* Meet prospective clients on\-site as part of their decision\-making process, including evenings/weekends as needed.
* Work along side the restaurant’s Maître’d to address client questions on room layout, decor, and other event logistics throughout the planning process.
* Adjust the BEO as event details change, keeping all stakeholders current.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Participate in regular pre\-event meetings with the on\-site events team (GM, Maître'd, Chef, Bar Manager) to review upcoming events and confirm details.
* Hand off confirmed events cleanly to the on\-site team, ensuring nothing is lost in translation.

**Performance Monitoring \& Optimization**

* On an ongoing basis, monitor conversion rates, ease and success of event execution, and other relevant business metrics.
* Collaborate with the GM to adjust event parameters (pricing, packages, minimums, policies, etc.) as needed to keep offerings competitive and attractive to prospective hosts while remaining efficient for restaurant operations.

**Financial \& Administrative**

* Collect deposits and progress/final payments per the contract schedule.
* Ensure signed contracts include cancellation/postponement terms, deposit schedule, and certificate\-of\-insurance requirements for any outside vendors.
* Close out each event financially: final invoicing, settling the bill, and return of deposit where applicable.

**Post\-Event**

* Solicit post\-event feedback from hosts.
* Flag repeat\-booking opportunities (annual corporate holiday parties, recurring galas, etc.) and re\-engage past clients on a proactive schedule.
* Track and report on conversion rate, booked revenue, and pipeline status on a regular (e.g., weekly) basis.

**COMPENSATION**

* **Base hourly rate:** $20–$24/hour.
* **Commission basis: Share of Event Admin Fee collected.**  Warm leads (inbound via website, email, phone, or other unsolicited contact): 33% of Event Admin Fee collected. Cold leads (sourced through this person's own outreach/prospecting): 67% of Event Admin Fee collected
* **Definition of “cold”:** a lead with no prior inbound contact or marketing touch, directly attributable to this person's own prospecting (cold call/email, networking, referral relationships)

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Prior experience in restaurant, catering, or event planning/sales strongly preferred. If none, other hospitality experience is required.
* Familiarity with Tripleseat or comparable event booking/CRM software.
* Strong math skills; comfortable calculating pricing, deposits, and payment schedules accurately.
* Proficient with Excel/spreadsheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — proposals and client correspondence are a core part of the job.
* Fluent English language skills required.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple events at different stages of planning simultaneously.
* Sales\-driven, client\-facing personality with strong follow\-through.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Golden Steer is a digitally native food brand and restaurant company. We are anchored by the original Golden Steer Steakhouse in Las Vegas, a true dining institution as the oldest steakhouse in the city. What started as a single location restaurant has grown into two locations and a high growth eCommerce business where we ship our seasonings nationwide. We're scaling across channels, products, and geographies and we're building the team to match.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Golden Steer is hiring a Marketing Coordinator to be the operating engine behind marketing across all three of our businesses: our seasonings eCommerce line, Golden Steer Las Vegas, and Golden Steer New York. This is the person who turns the plan into shipped work. You will be the operational back bone, owning the marketing calendar, executing email, coordinating creative across paid and organic, while supporting restaurant marketing for both restaurants, and keeping every marketing initiative on schedule across three brands at once.

This is a senior coordinator seat. We are hiring someone who has already held this job, knows how the pieces fit, and is ready for the next rung. You will report to our Director of Organic Marketing. We are a small team and you’ll have an opportunity to work on several exciting projects that will set you up to have a big creative voice and eventually drive the direction of day to day marketing.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own one marketing calendar across all three brands, covering promos, product launches, restaurant events, and seasonal peak moments, with owners, dates, and dependencies the whole team can trust.
* Email execution for eCommerce \& Steakhouse. Sometimes that will require building one off emails, planning the schedule for sending. We have an email partner so the emphasis will be more on reporting back on what performed and what you would change.
* Creative operations. Write and route briefs, traffic assets into paid and organic, hold naming conventions in Motion and Meta Ads Manager, and work with our Content Coordinator to keep the asset library clean enough that anyone can find the right file in under a minute.
* Organic social coordination under the Director of Organic Marketing. Own the Social calendar across brands, coordinate posts with creative partners, schedule and publish, and keep community response times tight.
* Project\-manage campaigns and launches from brief through go\-live and post\-mortem. Build timelines, coordinate stakeholders, track deliverables, proactively flag roadblocks, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Paid media support. Keep trafficking, tagging, and QA airtight, pull weekly performance numbers, and flag what needs attention before it turns into a problem.
* Restaurant marketing for Las Vegas and New York. Local partnerships, reservations platforms, events, in\-restaurant collateral, and whatever the GMs need to drive covers.
* PR and influencer logistics. Press requests, sample sends, hosted visits, and content collaborations, coordinated end to end.
* Weekly reporting. Pull the numbers, put them in a consistent format every week, and surface the three things worth acting on.
* Post\-mortems. Every promo gets closed out with what we spent, what we made, and what we do differently next time.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**We're prioritizing skills in this order:**

* Execution (must be expert). You get things done, on time, without being chased. You take an ambiguous priority, break it into steps, and close it out. This is the most important thing.
* Organization (must be excellent). Your calendars, trackers, and files are clean and current. Nothing falls through, and the team can see status without asking you for it.
* Marketing judgment (must be capable, owned expertise). You understand why a campaign is built the way it is, you can read the numbers, and you have opinions. We will keep developing this with you.

**In addition, you should bring:**

* Real reps. 3 to 4 years in a marketing coordinator, marketing associate, or marketing operations role, ideally at a DTC brand, a hospitality group, or an agency serving them. You have run a calendar, sent the sends, and owned deadlines that mattered.
* Ownership without hand holding. You are given the outcome and you figure out the path.
* Comfort with numbers. AOV, ROAS, CTR, CVR, open and click rates. You can pull them, format them, and explain what moved.
* Range across brands. eCommerce, a Las Vegas institution, and a new New York restaurant have different customers and different needs. You can hold all three in your head in the same week.
* A genuine love of food and hospitality. You will be working inside two restaurants and a seasonings brand, and this should excite you.
* Flexibility. Restaurants and launches do not run on a 9 to 5\. Some evenings and weekends come with the territory.

**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU...**

* Have already done this job somewhere and are ready for the promotion.
* Are the most organized person on any team you have been on, and it shows in the systems you leave behind you.
* Move fast and close loops. Nothing sits untouched in your inbox for three days.
* Would rather ask a blunt question today than surface a problem next week.
* Get real satisfaction from making other people's work land on time and land well.
* Are comfortable executing within a small team but interacting with big senior leaders across lines
* Have an appreciation for the brand. We opened in 1958, the history matters, and every asset has to feel like us.
* Understand personas. On eCommerce our customers are largely suburban Gen X, Boomer, and Silent Generation home cooks, which is a different audience from the people booking a table in New York or Las Vegas.
* Like being in the room. This role is in person in New York, with periodic travel to our Las Vegas restaurant.

**TOOLS WE USE**

* CapCut
* Canva
* Sprout Social
* Google Analytics
* Shopify
* Klaviyo
* Motion
* Slac

**Location: New York City \- Hybrid Role. Only candidates currently living in NY, NJ, and CT will be considered.**

Afficiency is seeking an Account Manager (NY\-Hybrid) to support and grow relationships with our distribution partners. Reporting directly to the Chief Growth Officer, this individual will play a critical role in onboarding new partners and agents, coordinating successful launches, and driving ongoing engagement and growth across Afficiency’s distribution network.

**This is a high\-activity role that requires exceptional organization, urgency, resourcefulness, and follow\-through. The Account Manager must be able to manage numerous partner needs and workstreams simultaneously while using AI, automation, and other productivity tools to create a scalable and consistently high\-quality partner experience.**

The successful candidate will be highly solutions\-oriented and proactive in identifying impediments to success, whether within their own responsibilities or across agent onboarding, contracting, and partner launch processes. This person will work collaboratively with internal teams to understand root causes, develop practical solutions, and continually improve operational performance and the partner and agent experience.

Success in this role means more than completing assigned tasks. The Account Manager is expected to identify what may prevent partners and agents from succeeding, take ownership of moving issues forward, and work across the organization to develop solutions that improve onboarding speed, contracting efficiency, partner performance, and the overall distribution experience.

**Responsibilities**

**Partner and Agent Onboarding**

Lead onboarding activities for new distribution partners, ensuring a seamless and well\-organized launch experience.

Support the onboarding and contracting of agencies, agents, and other distribution partners, helping ensure requirements are completed accurately and efficiently.

Serve as a primary point of contact for partners and agents throughout the onboarding and implementation process.

Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Growth, Operations, Licensing and Contracting, Compliance, Product, and Technology to drive successful launches.

Develop and maintain onboarding plans, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and success metrics for each partner.

Monitor onboarding and contracting activity, identify incomplete requirements or process bottlenecks, and proactively drive outstanding items toward resolution.

Anticipate potential impediments to onboarding, contracting, integration, or launch and address them before they affect timelines or the partner experience.

Identify recurring points of friction and work with the appropriate teams to implement practical, scalable solutions.

**Account Management and Partner Success**

Build trusted relationships with distribution partners and serve as their primary day\-to\-day contact.

Manage a high volume of partner and agent communications, requests, meetings, deliverables, and follow\-up activities.

Maintain a clear understanding of each partner’s priorities, performance, open items, impediments, and growth opportunities.

Conduct regular business reviews and identify opportunities to increase sales, engagement, and partner satisfaction.

Monitor key performance indicators and provide partners and internal stakeholders with actionable insights and recommendations.

Proactively identify issues that could affect partner or agent success and coordinate the appropriate internal resources to resolve them.

Support partner retention and expansion by identifying unmet needs and opportunities to deepen the relationship.

**Solutions Development and Continuous Improvement**

Proactively identify impediments that could prevent the Account Manager, an agent, or a distribution partner from achieving a successful outcome.

Investigate the root causes of delays, errors, recurring questions, or underperformance rather than addressing only the immediate symptoms.

Bring forward thoughtful recommendations and potential solutions rather than simply escalating problems.

Work collaboratively with internal teams to design and implement improvements to processes, technology, communication, documentation, and training.

Look for patterns across partner and agent experiences and use those insights to identify broader improvement opportunities.

Develop practical, scalable solutions that improve onboarding speed, contracting efficiency, data quality, partner responsiveness, and overall performance.

Monitor the effectiveness of process improvements and refine solutions based on performance data and stakeholder feedback.

**Activity Management and Process Optimization**

Manage numerous accounts, projects, agent onboarding cases, contracting activities, and partner workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail.

Maintain clear visibility into account activity, ownership, deadlines, dependencies, impediments, and next steps.

Establish effective systems for prioritizing work, documenting decisions, tracking commitments, and ensuring timely follow\-through.

Develop scalable processes, templates, workflows, and reporting practices that enable Afficiency to support a growing partner and agent base.

Use AI, automation, CRM, and productivity tools to improve workflow efficiency, prepare communications, summarize meetings, organize information, maintain documentation, and identify required follow\-up.

Apply sound judgment when using AI tools, including reviewing outputs for accuracy, protecting confidential information, and complying with company policies.

Identify repetitive or manual activities that can be standardized, automated, or completed more efficiently.

Use reporting and operational data to identify delays, trends, capacity constraints, and opportunities for improvement.

new_jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator-Manufacturing
new_jobs.description:
**Purchasing Coordinator – Manufacturing**

Starflex Fabrication is seeking a dependable, organized, and proactive Purchasing Coordinator to manage purchasing activities supporting our manufacturing operation.

This position will be responsible for the procurement of all materials, components, supplies, and consumables required to keep production running. The ideal candidate understands that purchasing in a manufacturing environment is more than placing purchase orders—it requires monitoring material requirements, maintaining supplier relationships, tracking deliveries, controlling costs, and communicating potential shortages before they impact production.

Experience in sheet metal fabrication or a similar manufacturing environment is a strong plus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day purchasing activities for the facility, including:
* Sheet metal and plate
* Structural steel, tubing, angle, channel, and other raw materials
* Hardware and fasteners
* Welding supplies and consumables
* Powder coating and finishing supplies
* Shop supplies, tooling, and production consumables
* Safety and maintenance supplies
* Most general office supplies
* Review production requirements and MRP data to identify material and purchasing needs.
* Create, issue, and maintain purchase orders.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure materials arrive when required.
* Communicate material shortages, delivery delays, back orders, and other supply concerns before they affect production.
* Obtain and compare supplier quotations for pricing, availability, lead time, and freight.
* Collaborate with suppliers to maintain competitive pricing and reliable delivery performance.
* Coordinate purchasing requirements with Operations, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Accounting.
* Verify purchased materials and components meet required specifications, quantities, and revisions.
* Assist with resolving receiving discrepancies, incorrect shipments, damaged material, and supplier quality issues.
* Maintain accurate purchasing information, supplier records, pricing, and lead times within the MRP system.
* Monitor inventory levels of commonly used production supplies and consumables.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, improved lead times, supplier consolidation, and inventory reduction.
* Support supplier evaluation and purchasing documentation requirements associated with Starflex Fabrication's ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System.

**Qualifications**

* Previous purchasing, procurement, buyer, or material planning experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems required.
* Experience with ProfitFab is highly preferred.
* Sheet metal fabrication, metalworking, or structural fabrication experience is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with purchasing carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, structural materials, hardware, and manufacturing consumables is preferred.
* Ability to read and understand purchase requirements, part numbers, material specifications, quantities, and basic manufacturing documentation.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open purchase orders and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong supplier communication and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable obtaining competitive quotations and negotiating pricing, lead times, freight, and delivery requirements.
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and general computer applications.
* Must be proactive and able to identify potential shortages or supply issues before they disrupt production.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

**What We Offer**

* Full\-time, hourly position
* 4\-day regular workweek: Monday through Thursday
* Overtime on Friday as needed
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance paid 100% by the company
* Life insurance paid 100% by the company
* Compensation based on experience

**About the Position**

This is a hands\-on purchasing position supporting a fast\-paced fabrication environment. The Purchasing Coordinator will have direct responsibility for ensuring the materials and supplies needed by Production are available when required.

Success in this position requires someone who takes ownership of purchasing requirements, follows open orders through delivery, communicates problems early, and understands how purchasing decisions directly affect production schedules, customer deliveries, and overall manufacturing performance.

Experience with ProfitFab and purchasing within a sheet metal or structural fabrication environment will be given strong consideration.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $26\.50 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience using an MRP or ERP system to determine purchasing requirements and manage purchase orders?
* Which MRP/ERP systems have you used?
* Are you comfortable being responsible for purchasing across multiple categories—including production raw material, hardware, consumables, shop supplies, maintenance items, and general office supplies?
* Do you have experience working in a sheet metal fabrication, structural fabrication, metalworking, or similar manufacturing environment?

Experience:

* Purchasing: 3 years (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* College Park, GA 30349 (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (API / CPaaS)
new_jobs.description:
**Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Vonage Communications APIs:**
-------------------------------



As an emerging leader in the $10B\+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.


**Why this role matters:**
--------------------------



As an Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR), you'll be the first point of contact for potential customers, playing a crucial role in generating and qualifying new sales opportunities. Your primary goal is to identify prospects, assess their needs, and schedule meetings with the sales team to drive pipeline growth.  

This role provides tremendous career growth opportunities within Vonage. We expect our SDRs to develop their sales careers and advance within the organization.


**Your key responsibilities:**
------------------------------


* Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through outbound prospecting, including calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.
* Leverage sales tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator and CRM software to research and engage with potential customers.
* Customize outreach strategies by researching prospects' goals, market trends, and pain points.
* Educate prospects on how Vonage API solutions can address their business challenges.
* Maintain detailed records of customer interactions and insights in our CRM system.
* Collaborate with marketing, account managers, and sales leadership to refine messaging and improve sales strategies.
* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly targets for qualified meetings and new opportunities.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------


* A proactive and determined mindset with a passion for delivering solutions to customers.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage high volumes of outreach efficiently.
* Excellent communication skills \- both written and verbal \- with a strong ability to listen and engage.
* A highly collaborative approach with a focus on teamwork and shared success.
* Creativity in prospecting strategies and the ability to take initiative.
* Proven ability to meet and exceed ambitious targets.
* Previous experience in Sales Development, particularly in a fast\-paced SaaS environment, is preferred. However, we welcome candidates eager to develop their sales careers.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other sales tools is an advantage.

**Where you will work:**
------------------------


* Hybrid work in Atlanta, GA
* Legal authorization to work in the USA is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
* This is a salaried role and would be part of our Commission Compensation structure. The overall compensation would be based on a 70/30 split.
* Disclaimer: The posted range represents the good faith salary for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined by factors including (but not limited to) geographic location, relevant experience, specific skill sets, and internal equity.


\#LI\-ML1

**There's no perfect candidate.** You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.



To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our **Privacy Notice**.


**Who we are:**



Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands \- such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat \- accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable\-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.



Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Consultant
new_jobs.description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  

  

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  

  

**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**


The Customer Success Consultant serves as the initial point of contact for an assigned portfolio of TriNet ASO clients. They serve as the Ambassador for our client admins and provide personalized support from a contact that knows payroll, payroll tax, platform support, reporting, HR \& benefit administration. The Consultant is backed by a team of experts and specialists. The role is critical to providing an outstanding client experience to TriNet's customers. This role works with customers who have mid\-level and/or average operational support needs.

  

* Deliver excellent services to customers through diligent, accurate, appropriate, timely, and easy\-to\-use valuable solutions to meet their needs.
* Employ a proactive approach to problem\-solving and issue resolution.
* Ensures proper triage, escalation, and effective resolution of all client inquiries, while providing relevant information, and making recommendations.
* Organize and prioritize work to ensure timely and efficient delivery of services to ensure customer expectations are met.
* Accountable to TriNet's customer retention and customer satisfaction goals.
* Demonstrate excellent communication skills.
* Effectively leverages resources to ensure business knowledge is current.
* Working knowledge of ASO products, services, and markets, including operations, cross\-functional workflows, and interaction between the various company units, processes, and systems.
* Knowledge in payroll, tax and compliance management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM \& HRIS applications and virtual meeting platforms.
* Solid understanding of API functionality and ways to address these types of customer requests.
* Maintain confidentiality of corporate data.
* Link client business needs to payroll/platform programs and operational services.
* Ability to work independently.
* Multi\-task, prioritize, and complete requests and assignments in a timely manner.

 **Required for All Jobs**

* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Complies with all policies and standards.

 **Education**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent industry work experience preferred.

 **Work Experience**

* 3\+ years payroll and customer service/relationship management required.
* 2\+ years industry experience; PEO, ASO or Payroll preferred.

  

Licenses \& Certifications

* Fundamentals of Payroll Certification (FPC) or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) through PayrollOrg preferred
* Lean Six Sigma Certification – IASSC preferred
* Certified Project Management Professional (PMP) – PMI preferred

  

The preferred location for this role is Atlanta, GA, and the salary range for this location is $25\.24 to $42\.93\. All qualified external applicants will be considered for an in\-office role, based in Atlanta. All qualified internal candidates are encouraged to apply and consider relocation to Atlanta and may be considered for remote hire at the company’s discretion. The candidate’s final salary offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, education, work location and experience.

  

A candidate’s compensation may also include bonuses consistent with TriNet’s corporate bonus plan.

  

Additionally, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, TriNet offers permanent full\-time employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(K) savings plan, an employee stock purchase plan, eleven (11\) Company observed holidays, PTO and a comprehensive leave program. Please click the following link for detailed information about our benefits offerings: https://www.trinet.com/documents/blt5b61a1040aae1904

  

Please Note: TriNet reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity.

**Required**

**Sales Benefits**

* the industry’s most competitive sales commission jobs with uncapped earning potential
