new_jobs.title: Youth Program Coordinator (High School - Academics)
new_jobs.description:
**Project: VISION is a nonprofit organization with a mission to help youth of Chicago’s Greater Chinatown community achieve their full potential by providing them with tools for educational, personal, and civic development. PV serves over 500 middle and high school youth each year out of its two Chinatown youth centers as well as three local school\-based sites. We are seeking a mission\-driven, creative, and energetic individual to join our team and serve as a Youth Program Coordinator within our High School Scholars Program.**

**The ideal candidate is committed to our mission and has experience and passion for working with young people. They are also driven by a growth mindset and thrive in a fast\-paced, impact\-based work environment.** 

The Youth Program Coordinator’s role will focus on supporting youths’ academic achievement via after school tutoring and enrichment programs. These programs aim to help youth build foundational knowledge and effective study skills and habits, which promote high school graduation and college access and success. The Coordinator will also work collaboratively with other team members to support other program components such as service learning and leadership programs.

The primary responsibilities of the Youth Program Coordinator will include the following:

* Oversee the daily after school tutoring program
* Facilitate day to day tutoring activities, ensuring that all students are engaged with their homework and getting the support that they need from their assigned tutors
* Supervise and facilitate the workflow of Lead Tutors and Tutors
* Develop and implement weekly academic enrichment activities, which strengthen student knowledge and skills in core high school subjects
* Coach and mentor a cohort of 20\-30 youth who experience academic challenges, including English Language Learners, by holding regular one\-on\-one goal\-setting and check\-in meetings with each youth
* Ensure accurate and thorough documentation of students’ academic activities and progress
* Understand the process and performance metrics that need to be captured for program evaluation and support program evaluation by collecting data and utilizing evaluation tools:
* Track weekly student attendance and follow up with students to encourage consistent attendance and participation
* Collect and evaluate students’ quarterly grades, and coordinate additional academic support or interventions for students as needed
* Report program data and metrics via PV or funder designated tracking and reporting tools
* Train and evaluate Lead Tutors, Tutors, and volunteers, setting up and leading 1:1 meetings for feedback loops and continuous support/improvement, including, but not limited to hosting development sessions on best practices for tutoring and mentoring
* Recruit and enroll youth into the program
* Conduct outreach and build partnerships and collaborations with other local organizations and schools when needed as well as host community building events for youth
* Communicate with youth about program expectations and standards and create improvement plans with youth as needed

Other responsibilities include:

* Support other program activities when needed, including coordinating service learning activities and leadership workshops in collaboration with other Program Coordinators
* Provide administrative support to service and leadership programs, including student recruitment, data collection, and other grant compliance and administrative tasks
* Work with the Parent Engagement Coordinator to engage parents with regular communications and other supports
* Work with the Case Manager to identify youth who may need additional external services (e.g. supporting mental health, basic needs, etc.) and help coordinate access to resources as needed
* Help identify program improvement needs and implement program improvement plans
* Attend and actively participate in team meetings
* Attend trainings regularly to stay abreast of best practices in youth programming as well as to meet funder requirements
* Create and implement a 6\- week summer program, lesson planning, record keeping, and field trip planning for approximately 40\-45 youth participants, ages 14\-15 years old.

**Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's degree required
* Minimum of 1 year of experience working with high school youth required
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google applications
* Minimum of conversational spoken Chinese Cantonese and/or Mandarin highly preferred
* Other qualifications for consideration will be:
* Demonstrated strong interest in a nonprofit career in youth development
* Values alignment with the organization, including commitment to its mission and goals and the issues of AAPI and immigrant youth and families and the local Chinatown community
* Ability to problem solve, offering ideas and suggestions while working with team members to overcome challenges
* Self\-driven work ethic and resilience as demonstrated by exhibiting ownership of projects, taking initiative, and able to adapt to shifting priorities and needs of the organization
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and capacity to manage multiple projects and occasional high volume of work with efficiency and without sacrificing quality
* Positive attitude with ability to problem solve in the face of challenges and turn negative outcomes into learning opportunities as well as using feedback to implement changes as needed
* Comfortability with working independently but also able to work in a team environment and willing to ask for help when needed
* Strong verbal and written communication skills along with strong interpersonal skills
* Understanding of restorative justice and implementation within a program as well as conflict resolution skills
* Experience managing others, including providing training, supervision, and feedback to team members

**To apply, please send a cover letter and resume to us via email at careers@proje

new_jobs.description:

**Business Unit:** Rush Medical Center


**Hospital:** Rush University Medical Center


**Department:** Orthopedic Surgery\-Res Adm

**Shift: Shift 1**

**Pay Range:** $23\.12 \- $32\.66 per hour
  

Rush salaries are determined by many factors including, but not limited to, education, job\-related experience and skills, as well as internal equity and industry specific market data. The pay range for each role reflects Rush’s anticipated wage or salary reasonably expected to be offered for the position. Offers may vary depending on the circumstances of each case.


Job Summary:
  

The Clinical Research Coordinator I (CRC I) supports the conduct of clinical research studies across a range of disciplines. Receives direction from principal investigator, supervisor, or other staff involved in research protocol(s). Responsibilities include participant recruitment and interaction, study data collection and entry, maintenance of study and regulatory documentation, sponsor communication, and adherence to study protocols and policies. The CRC I executes defined study tasks with guidance, ensuring operational compliance, accurate data entry, and participant safety. Exemplifies the Rush mission, vision and values and acts in accordance with Rush policies and procedures.


Required Job Qualifications:
  

Education:
  

* Bachelor’s degree

Experience:
  

* 0\-2 years of experience in a research study or other relevant experience

OR
  

Experience (in lieu of a degree)
  

* Two (2\) years’ total experience, where 1 year is supporting or coordinating research studies

  

Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:
  

* Time Management – Ability to meet deadlines and manage assigned study tasks.
* Problem\-Solving – Ability to troubleshoot routine field issues and use discretion to escalate appropriately when unplanned events arise.
* Attention to Detail – Strong attention to accuracy in data collection and documentation.
* Participant Relations – Ability to build rapport, navigate sensitive topics, and maintain participant confidentiality.
* Communication Skills – Effective verbal and written communication skills with participants and internal study teams.
* Team Collaboration – Ability to collaborate within multi\-disciplinary team settings and follow established workflows.
* Flexibility – Availability to work evenings, overnight shifts, or weekends if required by study protocols.
* Travel Readiness – Availability for local travel as necessary.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

Preferred Job Qualifications:
  

Experience:
  

* Two (2\) or more years prior experience in clinical research or related field
Job Responsibilities:
  

1\. Recruits, consents, screens, schedules, tracks and provides study updates to study participants throughout the conduct of the study.
  

2\. Collects and enters data into study case report forms and/or electronic data capture system and responds to queries in a timely manner.
  

3\. Assists in preparing simple data summaries, reports, or charts to support study documentation and reporting requirements.
  

4\. Maintains accurate and complete procedural documentation including study participant and site level documentation in compliance with institutional, local, state and federal guidelines and regulations related to clinical research.
  

5\. Verifies data against 100% of source documentation for accuracy before entry into case report forms and electronic data capture systems to ensure timeliness and audit readiness.
  

6\. May collect, process and ship potentially biohazardous specimens.
  

7\. Administers structured tests and questionnaires according to research study protocols. May utilize study\-related technology and equipment as part of assessment procedures.
  

8\. Provide ongoing study status updates and responds to questions from PI, Administrator, department stakeholders, Sponsor and Compliance throughout the conduct of the study.
  

9\. Maintains study flow by communicating promptly with study participants and coordinating with study team members as directed.
  

10\. Participate in auditing and monitoring visits. Gather and communicate unanticipated problems (protocol deviations, adverse events, and serious adverse events).
  

11\. Work with PI(s), sponsor, compliance, clinical staff and/or manager to identify and improve routine processes as it relates to the conduct of the research study.
  

12\. Other duties as assigned.  

  

  



Rush is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

* Adaptability

new_jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Let's be honest: families don't remember the name of a scheduling system. They remember the person who made their week easier.



At North Shore Pediatric Therapy, that person is the Family Child Advocate (FCA) — the calm in the chaos, the voice of reassurance, the behind\-the\-scenes orchestrator ensuring every child gets the care they deserve and every clinician walks into a day that runs smoothly.



Here, FCAs are trusted partners to families, real\-time problem solvers, and key players in providing the exceptional experience NSPT is known for. When a parent is overwhelmed, a child needs an urgent reschedule, or a clinic is juggling 30 moving pieces at once… **you're the one who turns stress into solutions.**



This is a **full\-time, in\-center position** with a **schedule of 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM****.** You'll primarily work from our Chicago (Bucktown), IL location. Approximately 50% of your time will be spent in the community building relationships. Compensation ranges from $21\-25 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.


**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------



Every hour of therapy counts — for a child learning to eat independently, say their sibling's name, or build the confidence they've never had before. You make those moments possible by keeping schedules full, communication clear, and families supported.



Across our centers, our therapists, Clinical Directors, and families will tell you the same thing: "I don't know what we'd do without our FCA."


**Who Thrives in This Role**
----------------------------


* A natural helper who finds joy in making someone's day smoother.
* A multitasker who can juggle 10 moving pieces without losing the warmth in their voice.
* A communicator who knows how to spin chaos into clarity.
* A schedules\-and\-systems thinker who loves finding the fastest path to a solution.
* A relationship\-builder who wants families to feel seen, supported, and appreciated.


If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!


**What** **You'll** **Do**
--------------------------


**Family Experience \& Operations**


* Be the go\-to support for families (schedule changes, questions, updates)
* Turn cancellations into makeups and keep schedules running smoothly
* Make real\-time adjustments as things shift
* Partner with Clinical Directors and therapists
* Keep the clinic organized, stocked, and running efficiently


**Marketing \& Growth (****50%)**


* Support local outreach efforts (schools, events, community partners)
* Help coordinate and host tours for prospective families
* Assist with center events and family engagement initiatives
* Drive online reputation (reviews, testimonials, family follow\-ups)
* Partner with leadership on simple, high\-impact marketing efforts
* Be the face of the center in the community

**Why** **You'll** **Love Working Here**
----------------------------------------



You're not just managing logistics — you're shaping a family's entire experience of therapy. You'll join a supportive team, build real relationships with families, and play a vital part in helping kids access the care they need.



If you're looking for a role where every day is meaningful and every detail matters, we'd love to talk.

new_jobs.title: Catering Event Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Catering Operations Manager**

Hours: Tuesday\-Saturday


Customary Days: Sunday through Saturday


Customary Hours: Varies to include evenings, holidays, and extended hours as needed.


Location: Chicago,IL

**About One Off Hospitality:**


For almost 30 years, One Off Hospitality has developed and operated some of Chicago’s most beloved places to eat and drink. More importantly, we’re a group of people – chefs, hospitality veterans, managers and creators – who believe in the power of treating our guests like family and our restaurants like home.

**Job Summary**


The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the successful execution of off\-premise catering events from planning through completion. This position manages event logistics, staffing, food and equipment transportation, setup and breakdown, client service, and operational standards. The ideal candidate is highly organized, solutions\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple events, teams, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**Responsibilities**:


* Oversee daily catering operations and ensure events are executed efficiently, professionally, and according to company standards.
* Coordinate all operational details for off\-premise events, including staffing, transportation, equipment, food, rentals, setup, service, and breakdown.
* Review event orders and production sheets to ensure all event requirements are understood and properly communicated.
* Develop staffing plans and schedules based on event size, service style, location, and operational needs.
* Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate catering staff, servers, bartenders, captains, porters, and event support personnel.
* Lead event teams onsite and serve as the primary operations contact for staff, vendors, venues, and clients when required.
* Collaborate with the warehouse manager to ensure food, beverage, equipment, décor, and supplies are accurately loaded, transported, delivered, and returned.
* Collaborate with the warehouse manager to establish and maintain efficient systems for loading vehicles, inventory control, equipment organization, and event breakdown.
* Monitor labor costs, overtime, product usage, and operational expenses while maintaining service quality.
* Coordinate with culinary, sales, event planning, and administrative teams to ensure seamless communication and execution.
* Troubleshoot event\-day issues and make quick, professional decisions when unexpected challenges arise.
* Maintain high standards for food safety, sanitation, personal appearance, customer service, and workplace safety.
* Conduct post\-event reviews and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, profitability, and guest experience.
* Manage relationships with venues, rental companies, staffing agencies, transportation providers, and other operational partners.
* Coordinate with the warehouse to ensure all company vehicles, catering equipment, tools, and supplies are properly maintained and accounted for.
* Assist with forecasting operational needs and developing procedures that support company growth.
* Attend menu meetings, sales meetings, and production meetings as scheduled
* Attend networking events
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications**

**Skills and Traits for Success:**

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and reliable follow through
* A customer\-centered approach to hospitality
* Knowledge of current industry trends
* Strong creative, presentation, and problem\-solving skills
* Creative skills to provide innovative solutions and strong presentation skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with staff, vendors, and cross\-functional teams
* Experience working with Microsoft Office, Tripleseat, Canva,7shifts, Gmail, Google Docs or similar programs a plus

**Required Education/Experience:**

**Qualifications**

* 3–5\+ years of experience in catering, hospitality, events, restaurant operations, or a related field.
* Previous management or supervisory experience.
* Experience with off\-premise catering and event execution strongly preferred.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple events and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to remain calm and make decisions under pressure.
* Strong understanding of staffing, event logistics, and customer service.
* Comfortable working evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on event schedules.
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record, if driving company vehicles is required.
* Food safety certification such as ServSafe is preferred.
* Ability to lift and move catering equipment and supplies, typically up to 50 lbs.


Key Performance Indicators
Success in this role will be measured by:

* Successful, on\-time execution of events
* Client satisfaction and retention
* Labor cost management
* Accurate event staffing
* Minimal equipment/product loss
* Operational efficiency
* Staff performance and retention
* Food safety and compliance
* Effective communication between departments
* Profitability of catered events


Physical Requirements

* Regularly required to communicate with clients, team members, and vendors in person and by phone
* Frequently required to stand, walk, and use hands for office and event\-related activities


More detail about One Off Hospitality Group part of One Off Hospitality Group

Lead and direct V\&V’s account development/management and selling efforts to assertively increase revenue and tonnage sales through national and regional Food Service chains.

* Partner with Sales Managers and their sales teams to develop and manage relationships with buyers and other key decision makers/influencers at these customers’ buying/operating centers.
* Responsible for managing customer total profit and loss results. Develop, monitor and support the implementation of agreed to marketing and sales promotion plans with these customer.

* Work with the National Sales Director to identify and prioritize national Food Service chains and regional chains in target markets for growth that V\&V Supremo Foods will aggressively pursue

* Proactively build senior level relationships, introduce new products, identify and gain agreement for immediate sales opportunities and marketing programs, review historical sales results and the value they have created for Food Service chains, and develop longer\-term account strategies by calling on these customers’ headquarters location.
* Establish and communicate priorities to brokers and distributors in implementing longer\-term account plans and short\-term sales plans for these national accounts.
* Partner with the Sales teams, brokers and distributors to develop and manage relationships and achieve sales goals with key individuals at these customers’ regional offices and to ensure that agreed to sales and marketing programs are effectively implemented in the field.
* Work with customer buyers and Sales Managers to develop accurate sales budgets and forecasts for designated customers.
* Responsible for resolving problems that negatively impact sales with designated customers
* Share important customer and competitor information with the Sales team.
* Provide timely and accurate reports, budgets, forecasts and other data as required.
* Responsible for ensuring that accounts receivables are not delinquent.
* Responsible for complying to all Safe Quality Food (SQF) polices/procedures and requirements for position.
* Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.

**Performance Metrics**

* Food Service national accounts revenue and tonnage attainment vs. goals
* Food Service national accounts overall profitability vs. goals.
* New product introductions.
* Customer satisfaction.
* The quality and successful implementation of customer\-specific account plans.
* A/R responsibility.
* Data reporting accuracy.

Regionally assigned customers

* Finance Dept.

* Other National Accounts Managers

* Knowledgeable of sales through customer warehouses, distributors, brokers and DSD.
* Able to take ownership for the Food Service business nationwide from a strategic perspective, and to drive sales with national accounts.
* Effective leader/communicator
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build very good working relationships at the national account and major regional account level.
* Hands\-on and can\-do attitude
* Analytic skills, data interpretation, ability to prepare and deliver effective presentations.

**Necessary Experience**

**Requirements:**

* Outside B2B sales and proven successful track record, including national. Grocery account management experience
* 5 plus years continuous experience in Food Industry sales.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in perishables, ideally dairy.

Account Manager  

Downers Grove, IL  

  

**Hours:** Monday \- Friday 7:30\- 4:30 \+ On Call  

  

  

**Who we are:** ServiceMaster DSI provides restoration across the country. We are the nation’s largest ServiceMaster franchise company.  

  

With continued investment in education, the latest tools and technology, and expert training, we are industry leaders in disaster restoration cleaning and are known for the great care we take with clients and employees alike.  

* Our community\-like work environment focuses on providing extensive training to service our clients with the most advanced equipment in the restoration industry.
* We believe that engaged and happy employees make ServiceMaster DSI an amazing place to work where we are always ready to help families and businesses recover from disasters.

  

**The position:** Account Manager  

This position would require being in any one of our 16 locations Monday thru Friday during business hours and be available after hours and on weekends to fulfill the on\-call duties for the Account Management Department.  

  

The Account Manager deals with day to day interactions, communications, and management of disaster restoration mitigation claims/jobs across the country. You will be working directly with customers, employees and insurance companies to deliver best in class customer service related to our restoration services. This role coordinates and facilitates efforts and problem solving between multiple areas of the organization, and projects. Acts as a single point of contact for Field staff and customers, as well as provides guidance on current insurance and other requirements or guidelines.  

The starting rate for this position is $17/hr and is negotiable based on experience.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include:**  

Effectively leads the day to day management of claims via claims management software and service with successful outcomes delivering against (Cost, Quality, and Speed) resolution metrics. Drive world class customer service.  

  

Account Management capabilities including ability to organize and prioritize claims or issues are a plus. Ability to shift priorities based on business needs while still meeting expectations in a timely manner.  

  

Assist in review of Project Management written claims to be uploaded based on SM's quality standards and guidelines \& price ensuring all criteria are met according to the organizational requirements and expectations.  

  

Strong team members that will keep all Account Managers included and informed through clear and concise communication when needed. Looks for efficiency initiatives to resolve identified issues. Willing to continue to learn and try new solutions in a calculated manner to further the company's continuous success.  

  

**Minimum Requirements:**  

* 2 years Disaster restoration experience is a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent computer software skills and ability to learn.
* The ability to travel a minimum of 0\-5%.
* Position requires Monday \- Friday availability and On\-Call status (on\-call completed from home).
* Superior customer service and communication skills.
* Must pass background check and Pre\-employment drug screen

  

**Why Should You Apply?**  

* We offer a full spectrum of benefits including health, dental, vision, FSA, 401(k) with 10% match, supplemental disability and legal insurance policies, PTO and company phone and computer
* We work together – openly and cross\-functionally because it enables us to build relationships, learn together and win as a team.
* We go above and beyond for our clients and you’ll find that we have a dynamic environment where learning and growth opportunities are abundant and hard work and results are awarded.

  

Equal Employment Opportunity/Employer/Vets Welcome Here  

  

If you’re looking for a challenging and fulfilling career, be part of the ServiceMaster DSI family.

Flexible work from home options available.

All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to The ServiceMaster Company, LLC.*

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Big Happy is looking for an Account Manager to build and grow relationships with some of our most important brand and agency partners. Reporting to a Senior Account Manager, this role sits at the center of our client experience and ensures campaigns launch smoothly, perform strongly, and ultimately turn into long\-term partnerships.  

As the primary post\-sale lead for your accounts, you will guide campaigns from kickoff through reporting while partnering closely with internal teams to drive revenue and repeat business. You will combine strong client instincts, attention to detail, and a solutions\-first mindset to help clients get the most from Big Happy's platform. A white\-glove approach to service, paired with close coordination across teams, is central to succeeding in this role.
  

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-moving environment, enjoys building meaningful relationships, and takes pride in delivering thoughtful work that drives client success.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as the main point of contact for brand and agency clients across all post\-sale activities, including:
	+ Leading campaign kick\-off calls with media and creative agencies to ensure creative production aligns with campaign objectives, brainstorming custom creative (Sunrises, AR, 3D, Games, etc.), reviewing production timelines, and serving as a subject matter expert on all things Big Happy
	+ Gathering campaign launch materials — assets, brand guidelines, campaign messaging, third\-party tracking, site lists, block lists, etc. — and confirming accuracy for timely launch
	+ Leading creative production with the creative team and serving as liaison between the client and internal teams to bring a client's creative vision to life while aligning with Big Happy best practices
	+ Monitoring campaign performance and providing clients with weekly reporting, with an eye toward optimizing and showing improvement week over week against client KPIs
	+ Ensuring all campaign elements are accurately tracking and flagging discrepancies with PAS, Ops, and Tech teams
	+ Building and presenting end\-of\-campaign reports with a focus on actionable learnings and recommendations that drive client renewals or incremental growth
* Partner closely with Sales, Strategy, Creative, Tech, and Ops to keep client deliverables, campaign launches, and execution on track

### **Skills, Knowledge and Experience**

  

* 2\-4 years of experience in digital advertising, ideally within an agency, publisher, or ad tech environment
* Strong understanding of the digital media ecosystem and how brands, agencies, and publishers collaborate
* Experience managing campaigns across the full lifecycle, from kickoff to reporting
* Comfort working with third\-party measurement and verification partners such as IAS, DoubleVerify, DCM, Lucid, or Nielsen, — and ability to lead troubleshooting with third\-party vendors
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and the broader Microsoft Office suite, with the ability to translate campaign data into clear insights and compelling client narratives
* Familiarity with programmatic and managed service media environments; experience with platforms like DV360, Xandr, or The Trade Desk is a plus
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent presentation skills, including public speaking, and the ability to navigate ambiguity during client conversations
* Confidence engaging with senior leadership
* A genuine commitment to white\-glove client service — proactive, resourceful, and always looking to go the extra mile
* A team\-first mindset; this role depends on working closely and effectively across departments on a daily basis
* A collaborative, solutions\-oriented approach, with a genuine interest in refining processes to drive efficiency as the company grows
* Ability to work in a friendly and respectful manner at all times with Big Happy employees, partners, and clients

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Full\-time position with a competitive base salary
* Access to benefits, including Healthcare, Dental, and Vision
* FSA/HSA matching program
* Unlimited PTO — take what you need
* Big Happy\-provided laptop
* Participation in Big Happy's stock program
* Paid Parental Leave
* Half Day Fridays (excluding Q4\)
* Team Happy camaraderie — celebrating wins, learning from challenges, and fostering continuous career growth
* A workplace culture where you can be yourself, contribute meaningfully, and be valued for your impact


  

**Location:** Chicago \| Hybrid \| 3x/week in office  


  

**Total Compensation:** $80,500 \- $97,750 includes base pay \+ bonuses.### **About Big Happy**


Big Happy is a high\-growth company that combines the next generation of DOOH \+ mobile focused creative with publisher media to create an interaction across publisher web pages that wows the modern\-day consumer and drives brand outcomes. As the leader in highly engaging 2D and 3D DOOH and mobile ad creatives, Fortune 500 brand partners are constantly tapping into our end\-to\-end mobile targeting and creative platforms to reach their audiences on the go in the physical word, or at home \- wherever they may be.

A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.


The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.


White Cap is hiring immediately for an **Account Manager!**


Do you want to help build America’s skyline and your own future? White Cap is North America’s leading distributor for professional contractors. We supply everything contractors need to build our nation’s remarkable construction projects, including stadiums, roads, bridges, highways, residential housing, and more. We are hiring immediately for an **Account Manager!**


*Why a* ***career*** *with White Cap?*


* **Comprehensive wellness and financial benefits:** White Cap offers excellent benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, and more! Out Account Managers have **unlimited earning potential!**
* **Relax and recharge:** We offer a generous time off package, including paid maternity and parental leave.
* **Stability:** Since 2020, White Cap has doubled in size and continues to grow.
* **Unlimited career potential:** White Cap is a stable and growing company offering unlimited career potential.
* **Love where you work:** White Cap has been certified as a *Great Place to Work* .
* **Inclusive culture:** Work in a place that values and celebrates who you are.

*An* ***Account Manager*** *at White Cap…*


* Builds relationships and develops plans to increase sales and profitability for mid\-size accounts.
* Generates viable sales leads and prospects through market and account research, sales events, networking, vendor events and computer programs. Contacts assigned and prospective accounts to secure new business.
* Develops and executes profitable business plans for managing accounts. Teams with individuals within sales and key corporate personnel to communicate account plans, pricing, and offer assistance to drive sales.
* Accountable for attaining assigned sales quota, part margin and controllable expense objectives.
* Interacts with customers, vendors, and associates to resolve customer and service related issues.
* Maintains a current and competent base of product knowledge and applies that knowledge when servicing customers.
* Maintains and submits all required sales administration reports. Regularly attends company meetings.
* Generally has 2\-5 years of experience.

If selected for this position, the company will run a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) report. A requirement of this position is an acceptable MVR report.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Prior experience in Outside Sales to professional contractors.
* Familiarity with Company products and services.
* Spanish language proficiency.

At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting\-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.
  

  

This position is with our Consumer Brands business unit – where we empower our employees to bring the best Laundry \& Home Care and Hair products to people around the world.
  

  

**Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.**  

  

#### **What you´ll do**

* Own and grow the Ulta business, managing day\-to\-day account performance and delivering sales objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Ulta buying teams and key stakeholders.
* Lead account planning, forecasting, budgeting, and business reviews to identify growth opportunities and mitigate risks.
* Develop and execute strategies that drive distribution, placement, promotions, and retail sales.
* Leverage business insights, market trends, and competitive analysis to support decision\-making and account growth.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Education, Supply Chain, and other internal teams to execute key initiatives and product launches.
* Operate independently, proactively solving challenges and driving continuous improvement across the business.


#### **What makes you a good fit**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of sales or account management experience within the beauty industry.
* Direct Ulta account management experience strongly preferred.
* Experience managing large\-scale beauty businesses, including assortment, planogram, and retailer growth initiatives.
* Proven track record of building customer relationships and delivering sales growth.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables preferred), PowerPoint, and Word.
* Experience with Ulta's PIM Portal is a plus.
* Self\-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, strong business acumen, and ambition to grow within the organization.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.


#### **Some benefits of joining Henkel**

* **Health Insurance:** affordable plans for medical, dental, vision and wellbeing starting on day 1
* **Work\-Life Balance:** Paid time off including sick, vacation, holiday and volunteer time, flexible \& hybrid work policies (depending on role), and vacation buy / sell program
* **Financial:** 401k matching, employee share plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares, annual performance bonus, service awards and student loan reimbursement
* **Family Support:** 12\-week gender neutral parental leave (up to 20 weeks for parents giving birth), fertility support, adoption \& surrogacy reimbursement, discounted child and elderly care, and scholarships

new_jobs.title: LTL Business Development Associate - Ryan Transportation
new_jobs.description:
About Shamrock Trading Corporation
  
Ryan Transportation is part of Shamrock Trading Corporation, a family of brands that has been serving the transportation and logistics industries since 1986\. Shamrock offers factoring solutions, export financing, third\-party logistics, a fuel card program and trucking technology.
  
Shamrock’s mission since the start has been to create value and success for our customers, our partners and our people. Strong ethics, dedication to our customers and close attention to the marketplace are critical to the success and growth of the Shamrock brands. Shamrock is headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas, with multiple offices throughout the U.S. Our Chicago office is located in the heart of Lombard offering a convenient commute and quick access to several shopping, dining and recreational options. With panoramic views of the area and a winning culture, Shamrock is a great place to work in Chicago!
  
Why You’ll Love Working Here
  
Our award\-winning culture is a testament to our commitment to growth, recognition and empowerment. From day one, we prioritize employees first, encouraging them to think and act like owners and providing endless opportunities for growth and self\-development, both personally and professionally. Shamrock has been recognized as one of America’s 2025 “Most Loved Workplaces” by Newsweek.
  
At Shamrock, we hire bright, ambitious people and give them the tools they need for a successful, long\-term career here. Shamrock also offers a premier set of benefits for employees and their families:
  
* Unlimited Earnings: Uncapped commission, competitive base salary and ongoing opportunities to advance your professional career
* Training and Development: Industry\-leading training programs, including a Freight Immersion Training (FIT) Program for sales employees entering the transportation industry and a LEAD Program for aspiring leaders
* Medical: Fully paid healthcare, dental and vision premiums for employees and eligible dependents, and gym benefits
* Financial: Generous company 401(k) contributions, employee stock ownership after one year and free resources to build long\-term financial security
* Recognition and Awards: Sales incentives, quarterly employee awards and opportunities to celebrate individual and team success
* Work\-Life Balance: Competitive PTO, fully paid time off for holidays and opportunities to volunteer within your community


About the Role
  
Ryan Transportation, a Shamrock company, is seeking an accomplished and highly competitive sales professional to join our team as an LTL Business Development Associate. This role is designed for a driven hunter who thrives on winning new business and building long\-term client partnerships in the freight brokerage and third\-party logistics space, with a focus on LTL accounts.
  
In this position, you will be responsible for identifying, pursuing, and securing new LTL shipper accounts while strategically expanding relationships with existing customers. You will leverage deep industry knowledge, a consultative approach, and a relentless drive to deliver transportation solutions that create value and strengthen client relationships. Success in this position requires exceptional sales acumen, a proven track record of closing high\-value deals, and the ability to excel in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment. This is an in\-office, performance\-based role with significant earning potential for individuals who consistently meet and exceed business objectives.
  
What You’ll Do
  
* Consistently prospect and secure new LTL shippers, with a heavy emphasis on accounts in the small and mid\-sized business segments.
* Close and convert high\-potential prospects into long\-term clients
* Build, grow, and maintain strategic relationships with existing customers to maximize account value.
* Work with BDMs in the FTL and TM groups to identify other transportation mode opportunities.
* Identify and pursue opportunities to expand business within current accounts
* Manage and advance a robust sales pipeline through effective use of CRM for lead handling, call tracking, and opportunity management
* Serve as an industry expert in LTL shipping and LTL pricing and advise clients with insight and credibility
* Collaborate with leadership to refine sales strategies and drive business growth
* Oversee customer onboarding, including contract negotiation, account setup, and operational handoff


What You’ll Bring
  
* 1\-2 years of proven success in high\-performance B2B sales, preferably in LTL and freight brokerage, logistics, or a related industry
* Demonstrated ability to develop and close new business through cold calling, networking, and strategic outreach
* Track record of exceeding sales targets in a competitive, quota\-driven environment
* Proficiency with CRM tools and disciplined pipeline management
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to mentor and influence others
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication abilities
* Self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and able to thrive with minimal supervision
* Experience in transportation, manufacturing, distribution, or food industries a plus
* Willingness to travel as needed


Apply Today!
  
We’re so excited to connect with you! If you want to work with forward\-thinking people in an award\-winning culture, submit your application today.
  
Having trouble submitting your application? Contact us at Recruiting@shamrocktradingcorp.com for support.

new_jobs.title: Product Manager- Client Onboarding
new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.  

As a Product Manager in Client Onboarding and Servicing, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.  

**Job responsibilities**

* Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
* Builds the framework and tracks the product's key success metrics such as cost, feature and functionality, risk posture, and reliability
* Direct the principal activities across the end‑to‑end product delivery journey—intake, dependency management, release and deployment, and product operationalization—with a focus on feasibility and readiness.
* Leads the completion of change management activities across functional partners and ensures adherence to the firm's risk, controls, compliance, and regulatory requirements
* Effectively manages timelines and dependencies while monitoring blockers, ensuring adequate resourcing, and liaising with stakeholders and functional partners
* Maintain a transparent portfolio view of timelines, cross‑team dependencies, and environmental constraints; identify and resolve blockers early.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics
* Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management
* Demonstrated ability to execute operational management and change readiness activities
* Proven ability engaging with a technology and business audience alike
* Proficiency in data and analytics to inform prioritization, measure performance, and drive decisions.
* Deep experience with risk, controls, compliance, and regulatory requirements embedded in delivery.
* Strong structured problem\-solving skills (hypothesis\-driven analysis, root\-cause identification, prioritization) and the ability to translate complexity into clear executive narratives and decision\-ready materials.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management; ability to lead through influence and drive cross‑functional outcomes.




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
* Experience delivering automation and/or AI\-enabled capabilities (e.g., workflow automation, decision support, intelligent document processing, or AI\-assisted operations), including requirements shaping, backlog management, and post\-implementation performance tracking.
* Familiarity with responsible AI and automation control considerations in a financial institution environment (e.g., governance, documentation, monitoring, and policy adherence), with the ability to partner effectively with risk and control stakeholders.




**Additional information**

* Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

new_jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Excel Restoration is a fast\-growing restoration company specializing in water, fire, and mold mitigation, along with full\-service reconstruction. We pride ourselves on professionalism, accountability, and delivering exceptional service to our customers and partners.

As we continue to grow across our Elk Grove Village, IL and West Allis, WI locations, we’re looking for a creative, energetic Social Media \& Content Creator to help us build our brand and tell the Excel Restoration story online.

**The Opportunity**  
We’re looking for someone who can take the work we do every day and turn it into engaging content that people actually want to watch.

From documenting restoration projects and before\-and\-after transformations to highlighting our team, sharing educational content, and showcasing the day\-to\-day life of a restoration company, you’ll help bring the Excel Restoration brand to life across social media.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being behind the camera just as much as they enjoy being behind a computer. You should be comfortable coming up with content ideas, filming on location, editing videos, writing captions, and staying on top of social media trends.

You’ll work closely with our team and leadership to develop a consistent content strategy and create content that increases brand awareness, builds trust with customers and partners, and helps position Excel Restoration as a leader in the restoration industry.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute a consistent social media content strategy across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube
* Film high\-quality video and photo content at our offices, job sites, and restoration projects
* Capture before\-and\-after transformations, project walkthroughs, team spotlights, educational content, customer\-focused stories, and behind\-the\-scenes footage
* Edit short\-form videos and other social media content for online publishing
* Create engaging Reels, TikToks, Stories, Shorts, and other platform\-specific content
* Write captions, develop hooks, and help create content that encourages engagement
* Identify trending formats, sounds, topics, and content opportunities that can be adapted to the restoration industry
* Build and maintain a consistent social media posting schedule
* Collaborate with leadership and team members to develop new content ideas
* Help showcase the expertise, professionalism, culture, and personality of Excel Restoration
* Monitor social media performance and use analytics to identify what content is performing well
* Help grow our audience, engagement, and overall online presence
* Maintain an organized library of photos and video footage
* Travel between our Elk Grove Village, IL and West Allis, WI locations and job sites as needed

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience creating content for social media, either professionally or through personal projects
* Strong knowledge of platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube
* Experience filming and editing video
* Familiarity with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar
* A strong understanding of what makes short\-form content engaging
* Creative instincts and the ability to come up with new content ideas
* Strong communication and storytelling skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* Comfortable being around active job sites and working in a hands\-on environment
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple pieces of content at different stages
* Willingness to get out from behind the desk and capture content in the field
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with photography or videography
* Experience operating DSLR or mirrorless cameras
* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud
* Experience creating TikToks, Reels, or YouTube Shorts
* Experience managing a business or brand's social media accounts
* Experience with paid social media advertising
* Experience with graphic design
* Experience in construction, restoration, home services, real estate, or another field\-based industry
* A portfolio or examples of content you've created

**What Success Looks Like**  
In this role, success means making Excel Restoration more visible, recognizable, and engaging online.

* You'll help us consistently publish content that showcases our projects, educates our audience, highlights our team, and gives potential customers and partners a reason to trust and remember Excel Restoration.
* We aren't looking for someone who simply checks a box by posting three times a week. We're looking for someone who sees an interesting project, grabs a camera, finds the story, edits the footage, and turns it into something people want to watch.
* If you're creative, self\-motivated, comfortable in a fast\-paced environment, and excited about building something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person
